jobs.excerpt: It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!

We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

Public Partnerships LLC (PPL) provides helps people with disabilities, chronic illnesses, or other long-term health conditions stay at home and “self-direct” their care. Known as consumer direction in New York, this long-term care model empowers people to take control of who provides their services and where. PPL was selected to be the Statewide Fiscal Intermediary for the New York Consumer Directed Personal Assistance Program (CDPAP) starting in 2025. We will, along with a diverse alliance of service partners across the state, support the delivery of culturally sensitive and disability competent care to CDPAP participants. We are looking for people who share our passion for helping New Yorkers live happy, healthy, and independent lives to support CDPAP consumers and their personal assistants across a broad spectrum of services and functions.

Our culture attracts and rewards people who are compassionate, results-oriented, and driven to exceed customer expectations. We desire motivated candidates who are excited to join our fast-paced, consumer-focused environment, and who want to make a difference in helping transform the lives of the people we serve. 

Learn more about PPL and CDPAP at 

Job Summary

The Senior Network Security Engineer is a hands-on technical security leader responsible for ensuring that PPL's network environment — including its cloud-primary infrastructure in Microsoft Azure, secondary presence in AWS, Fortinet-protected physical locations, and remote-first workforce — is designed, configured, and operated in alignment with PPL's security requirements, standards, and regulatory obligations. Reporting to the Director of Cybersecurity Operations, this role defines network security requirements, reviews and validates network architecture and controls, performs security assessments and audits, and partners closely with the Infrastructure team's Sr. Network Engineer, who owns administration of PPL's network and network security devices. The role serves as the Information Security team's subject matter expert on network security — driving zero-trust strategy, supporting incident response, evidencing compliance, and protecting the confidentiality and integrity of Medicare and Medicaid protected health information (PHI).

Key Responsibilities

Network Security Strategy, Standards & Architecture Review

  • Define and maintain PPL's network security requirements, standards, and baselines for cloud, on-premises, and remote-access environments — including Fortinet firewall configuration baselines, Azure and AWS network security baselines, segmentation standards, and secure remote-access requirements.
  • Review and validate network architecture and design changes from a security perspective — providing requirements, recommendations, and sign-off as appropriate before changes are implemented by Infrastructure or Cloud Engineering.
  • Drive PPL's zero-trust networking strategy across cloud, physical, and remote-workforce environments — establishing the security model, segmentation principles, and identity-aware access requirements that Infrastructure and Cloud Engineering execute against.
  • Evaluate, recommend, and provide security requirements for new network security technologies (SASE/SSE platforms, NDR, DNS security, etc.) that improve visibility, reduce risk, and support automation across the enterprise.
  • Define network-layer and zero-trust controls for enterprise AI service traffic — including egress policies, conditional access, and data-leakage protections for approved AI assistants (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, Claude) to enable responsible AI use while protecting PHI and proprietary data.
  • Partner closely with the broader Infrastructure team — including the Sr. Network Engineer, systems and cloud engineers, and supporting infrastructure staff — to translate network security requirements into actionable engineering work and maintain consistent controls across Azure, AWS, Fortinet, and remote-access environments.
  • Collaborate with DevOps and Cloud Engineering teams to embed network security controls into infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines, and automated deployment patterns — ensuring network security is enforced consistently and at the speed of delivery.
  • Partner with Application Development teams on secure application network design — reviewing API exposure, service-to-service communication, ingress/egress requirements, and third-party integration patterns to ensure new and existing applications align with PPL's network security standards.

Network Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Conduct security reviews and assessments of PPL's network environment — including Fortinet firewall and wireless infrastructure (e.g., FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer), Azure network controls (NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, private endpoints, ExpressRoute/VPN gateways), AWS network controls (security groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, WAF, Transit Gateway, etc.), and ZTNA/VPN platforms.
  • Lead periodic firewall rule reviews, segmentation validation, access-path analysis, and review of third-party network connections (vendor VPNs, B2B integrations, partner tunnels) and approved AI service connections to identify overly permissive rules, stale exceptions, and gaps against PPL's security standards; partner with Infrastructure on remediation.
  • Validate secure configuration of network and network security devices against industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS, Fortinet hardening guides, cloud provider best practices) and PPL's internal standards — through periodic reviews and continuous posture monitoring where available.
  • Coordinate with the vulnerability management program to identify, prioritize, and track remediation of network-related vulnerabilities across Fortinet devices, cloud network services, and supporting infrastructure.
  • Lead architecture-level network security review for new initiatives — including new applications, SaaS solutions, and IT purchases with network connectivity or data-flow implications — ensuring alignment with PPL's network security standards.
  • Develop and report network security posture metrics to leadership — including firewall rule review coverage, segmentation gaps, network vulnerability remediation, and progress against zero-trust initiatives — to inform program prioritization and demonstrate control effectiveness.

Network Threat Detection & Incident Response

  • Serve as the Information Security team's senior escalation point for network-related security incidents — supporting investigation, containment, eradication, and recovery efforts across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Lead network forensics activities, including packet capture analysis, flow analysis (NetFlow, VPC flow logs), and review of firewall, proxy, and DNS logs to reconstruct attacker activity and inform response decisions.
  • Utilize the SIEM platform during incident investigation and response — running network-focused queries across firewall, proxy, DNS, and cloud network telemetry to correlate events, identify scope, and reconstruct attacker activity.
  • Leverage the enterprise XDR platform to correlate network signal with endpoint, identity, and email data during incidents — enabling cross-domain visibility that informs containment, remediation, and root-cause analysis.
  • Lead network-specific threat hunting and adversary behavior analysis aligned to MITRE ATT&CK and current threat intelligence — particularly for techniques involving network reconnaissance, lateral movement, and data exfiltration in cloud and remote-access environments — in partnership with the Security Operations, IT & Cloud Security, AppSec/DevSecOps, and GRC functions across the broader incident response program.
  • Direct network-layer containment actions (firewall blocks, segmentation changes, DNS sinkholing, conditional access enforcement, etc.) during active incidents — working through Infrastructure for execution and ensuring changes are documented and reversible.
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews, identifying network-related root causes and recommending architectural, configuration, or operational improvements.

Monitoring & Detection Oversight

  • Provide security oversight of network monitoring tools and platforms — including NDR, IDS/IPS, DNS security, and the use of firewall, proxy, and TLS-inspection logs — ensuring detections, alerts, and logging meet PPL's security requirements.
  • Collaborate with SOC analysts on tuning network-layer detections to reduce false positives, improve signal quality, and align with current threat intelligence.
  • Maintain situational awareness of emerging network-based threats, vulnerabilities, and attack vectors (e.g., ransomware command-and-control patterns, DNS tunneling, cloud lateral movement) and translate them into updated requirements, detections, and review priorities.
  • Maintain documentation for network security standards, review procedures, runbooks, and assessment findings to support operational consistency and audit readiness.

Risk, Compliance & Governance Support

  • Provide network security input into risk assessments, evaluating systems, applications, vendors, and services for network-layer exposure and recommending mitigating or compensating controls.
  • Partner with the GRC function to evidence network security controls for NIST 800-53, HIPAA, SOC 2, and CMS audits — including firewall rule review evidence, segmentation documentation, cloud network configuration, and remote-access control artifacts.
  • Collaborate with the GRC function on the development, maintenance, and enforcement of network security policies, standards, and procedures across the organization.
  • Review and approve WAF and firewall policy changes, AI service access requests, and temporary security exceptions — ensuring requests align with PPL's network security standards and that exceptions are documented, time-bounded, and tracked through to remediation or renewal.

Collaboration, Communication & Awareness

  • Partner across Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, DevOps, Application Development, and the broader Cybersecurity team to translate security requirements into effective controls without disrupting business operations.
  • Communicate network security findings, risks, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical audiences, including leadership.
  • Contribute to security awareness initiatives, particularly around safe remote work practices, secure remote access, and phishing/social-engineering threats with a network component.
  • Provide technical mentorship and direction to junior security and SOC staff on network security concepts, tooling, and investigation techniques.

Required Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of information security and network security principles, controls, and best practices across cloud, on-premises, and remote-workforce environments.
  • Hands-on experience assessing, configuring, or operating Fortinet firewall environments (FortiGate, FortiAnalyzer, FortiManager) at scale; ability to review configurations, rules, and policies for security compliance.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of cloud network security in Microsoft Azure (NSGs, Azure Firewall, Application Gateway/WAF, private endpoints, hub-and-spoke design, ExpressRoute/VPN gateways) and AWS (security groups, NACLs, AWS Network Firewall, WAF, Transit Gateway, PrivateLink).
  • Experience defining security requirements and reviewing architectures for ZTNA and secure remote access for distributed and remote-first workforces, including conditional access, identity-aware proxies, and integration with modern identity platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience with network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and zero-trust networking principles.
  • Proficiency in network protocols, routing, switching, TLS inspection, and packet/flow analysis sufficient to support detection engineering and incident response across cloud and on-premises environments.
  • Proven ability to investigate, analyze, and respond to network-based security incidents, including log analysis, alert triage, and forensic review.
  • Exposure to artificial intelligence platforms and the network security considerations specific to them — including data egress controls, secure access to AI services, and monitoring of AI-related network traffic.
  • Strong understanding of healthcare-relevant regulatory and framework requirements (HIPAA, NIST 800-53, SOC 2, CMS) as they apply to network security controls.
  • Ability to communicate network security findings, risks, and recommendations effectively to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

Qualifications:
Education:

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Network Engineering, Cybersecurity, or related field. Equivalent professional experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

Experience:

Minimum of 6–8 years of progressive experience in network engineering and/or network security, with at least 3 years in a dedicated network security role and demonstrated cloud network security experience.

Certifications (Preferred:

One or more of: Fortinet NSE 4 / NSE 5 / NSE 7, Microsoft AZ-700 (Azure Network Engineer Associate), AWS Advanced Networking Specialty or AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCNP Security, or GIAC GCIA / GCIH.

Preferred Attributes:

Experience in healthcare, financial services, or other regulated industries; familiarity with maturing security programs in cloud-primary, remote-first organizations; experience with infrastructure-as-code and automation for network security (Terraform, Ansible, scripting).

Working Conditions:

Office and Remote work.

Up to 10% of travel expected.

Supervisory Responsibility (If applicable):

No direct reports at this time; expected to provide technical leadership, mentorship, and direction to junior security staff and applicable contractors.

Compensation: $116,00 - $130,500

This role is eligible for a base salary within the posted range. Actual compensation will be determined based on a variety of factors, including skills, experience, and geographic location. Compensation may vary for positions based in high cost-of-labor markets.

Relationship Executive

£24,785- £28,000 plus benefits

Visa sponsorship: You must be eligible to work in the UK to apply for this vacancy. Cancer Research UK is not able to offer visa sponsorship.

Recruitment process: Competency based interview

At Cancer Research UK, we exist to beat cancer.

We’re looking for an inspiring Relationship Executive to work within the regional team to manage individual, group and corporate supporter relationships.

This role will provide an exceptional level of service, predominantly over the phone, to help maximise in year and lifetime value, and transition relevant supporters to Relationship or Legacy Managers to extend their journey.

What will I be doing?

  • Manage ongoing contact for low value to mid value and light touch relationships including and not limited to; individuals, fundraising groups and corporate organisations.

  • Provide excellent customer service to support fundraisers via phone, mail and e-mail.

  • Provide timely contact to supporters, providing reward, recognition, and fundraising materials as required.

  • Identify supporters with high value potential or specific stewardship requirements across income streams and pass relationships to the Relationship Manager to maximise income and build long term relationships, including legacy journeys.

  • Ensure supporter records are entered and maintained on systems and associated pipelines.

  • Dealing with compliance enquiries to ensure supporters are compliant with Fundraising Regulator and Charity Commission regulations, up to date with CRUK policies and procedures, and operating in line with Institute of Fundraising best practice.

What are we looking for?

  • Experience of providing excellent customer service.

  • Strong communication skills, in both verbal and written form with an ability to influence others using clear, candid communication - predominantly over the phone.

  • Good listening skills to build effective and valuable relationships with supporters.

  • Excellent organisation and time management skills.

  • Ability and confidence to solve straightforward problems with the direction, guidance and support of colleagues.

  • Build internal networks for collaboration and knowledge sharing across the region and department, with experience of working with colleagues to find new or better ways to do things and to make changes appropriately.

  • Excellent attention to detail and experience of entering and managing data in a database system.

  • Ability to understand the fundraising or charity/voluntary sector.

  • Applicants must be willing to work flexibly with the ability to travel for internal meetings across the division (approx. 2 per year). Home office space required.

Our organisation values are designed to guide all that we do.

Bold: Act with ambition, courage and determination

Credible: Act with rigour and professionalism

Human: Act to have a positive impact on people

Together: Act inclusively and collaboratively

We’re looking for people who can believe in and embody these organisation values and can use them to drive forward progress against our mission to beat cancer.

If you’re interested in applying and excited about working with us but are unsure if you have the right skills and experience we’d still love to hear from you.

Eligibility criteria

Internal candidates should ideally have completed their 6-month ‘getting started’ period before applying for other roles. You should also advise your current line manager at the point you make an internal application, or at the latest, at the point of being invited for an interview.

All internal candidates applying for a secondment, must have:

  • completed their getting started period

  • discussed their intention to apply and gained approval to apply with their line manager

  • been in their substantive (home) role for at least 6 months (this is only applicable if you have previously been on secondment)

If you do not confirm that you meet these requirements, we will not be able to progress your application.

For information about internal learning and development at Cancer Research UK please visit Fuse.

What will I gain?

We create a working environment that supports your wellbeing and provide a generous benefits package, a wide range of career and personal development opportunities and high-quality tools. Our policies and processes enable you to improve your work-life balance, take positive steps in your career and achieve your personal wellbeing goals.

You can explore our benefits by visiting our careers web page.

How do I apply?

We operate an anonymised shortlisting process in our commitment to equality, diversity and inclusion. CVs are required for all applications; but we won’t be able to view them until we invite you for an interview. Instead, we ask you to complete the work history section of the online application form for us to be able to assess you fairly and objectively.

For more information on this career opportunity please visit our website or contact us at .

For more updates on our work and careers, follow us on: Linked In, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

Our vision is to create a charity where everyone feels like they belong, benefits from and participates in, the work we do. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and cultures, in particular those from ethnic minority backgrounds who are currently under-represented.

We want to see every candidate performing at their best throughout the job application process, interview process and whilst at work. We therefore ask you to inform us of any concerns you have or any adjustments you might need to enable this to happen. Please contact or 020 3469 8400 as soon as possible.

  • Experience with ITSM and at least one additional ServiceNow product, such as CSM, HRSD, SPM, or App Engine.
  • Experience with Now Assist, Virtual Agent, or other ServiceNow AI and automation capabilities.
  • Proven experience building integrations using REST, SOAP, webhooks, or equivalent technologies.

  • Experience with code reviews, testing, release management, platform upgrades, and production support.

  • a commitment to sustainability - with initiatives such as our Environmental, Social, and Governance strategy and Act4Good programme

  • Work with event-driven and asynchronous architectures using technologies such as SNS, SQS, NServiceBus and RabbitMQ.
  • Plan and execute incremental migration waves rather than relying on traditional lift-and-shift approaches.
  • Design safe migration and cutover strategies for business-critical services.
  • Implement approaches such as blue/green deployments, parallel running, progressive traffic switching and rollback strategies.
  • Solve complex migration challenges involving shared databases, authentication, legacy dependencies and service-to-service integrations.
  • Work closely with engineering teams and stakeholders to identify dependencies, risks and delivery priorities.

Job Title: Senior HCM Cloud Platform & DevOps EngineerJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: Up to 10%Type of Travel: Continental US* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an HCM Cloud Platform & DevOps Engineer to design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and environment management framework supporting a major federal HCM modernization program. This program deploys Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM across multiple federal agencies and requires secure, reliable, high‑performance environments across DEV, TEST, STAGE, and PROD.

You will work within Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) in a FedRAMP Moderate+ boundary, build automated pipelines, maintain configuration baselines aligned to NIST SP 800‑128, and orchestrate quarterly Oracle cloud updates. Using tools such as Terraform, Jenkins, and Python, you will automate provisioning, environment replication, and disaster recovery operations. This role is ideal for engineers passionate about operating resilient and secure cloud platforms at federal scale.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM configuration promotion across all environments using Jenkins, Terraform, and Python.

  • Administer Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) resources in FedRAMP Moderate+ environments including compute, networking, storage, and IAM configurations.

  • Establish and maintain configuration baselines aligned with NIST SP 800‑128, ensuring deployments are fully traceable and auditable.

  • Orchestrate quarterly Oracle SaaS updates across program environments, coordinating regression testing, impact analysis, and rollback procedures.

  • Implement disaster recovery (DR) and business continuity (BC) capabilities including automated failover, backup/restore processes, and DR testing cycles.

  • Monitor performance, capacity, and availability using OCI monitoring tools, and configure automated remediation workflows to meet uptime SLAs.

  • Apply infrastructure‑as‑code practices through Terraform for provisioning, configuration management, and replicating environments consistently.

  • Enforce FIPS 140‑3 encryption requirements for all platform components; coordinate with cybersecurity engineers on key management and certificate lifecycle.

  • Manage environment refresh cycles, data masking, and sandbox provisioning to support agency onboarding and parallel deployment workstreams.

  • Develop and maintain operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, and deployment procedures supporting both daily operations and ATO documentation.

  • Participate in SAFe Agile ceremonies, contributing to sprint planning, infrastructure automation, and technical debt remediation.

  • Serve as the technical authority for the platform domain, defining standards, best practices, and design direction across workstreams and Agile Release Trains.

  • Lead and mentor engineering and functional team members; foster innovation, influence cross‑functional decisions, and represent technical strategy to program leadership.

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (U.S. Citizenship required).

  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • 10+ years of experience in cloud platform engineering, DevOps engineering, or enterprise systems administration.

  • 8+ years of hands‑on experience with OCI, AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, or comparable FedRAMP‑authorized cloud platforms.

  • Strong proficiency with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, GitLab CI, Azure DevOps) and experience automating build, test, and deployment workflows.

  • Hands‑on experience with Terraform or similar IaC tools for declarative cloud infrastructure management.

  • Proficiency in Python and/or Bash for automation, deployment orchestration, and monitoring.

  • Understanding of federal compliance requirements including FIPS 140‑3, NIST 800‑53, and FedRAMP control baselines.

  • Experience with configuration baselining, change control, and release management across multi‑environment enterprise deployments.

Desired:

  • 11+ years of cloud platform or DevOps engineering experience, including work on large‑scale OCI or Oracle SaaS deployments.

  • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect or Operations certification.

  • Experience managing Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM environments including quarterly updates, sandboxes, and refresh cycles.

  • Familiarity with NIST SP 800‑128 and federal configuration/change control boards.

  • Experience implementing DR/BC solutions including automated failover and RPO/RTO validation.

  • Knowledge of container orchestration and microservices (Kubernetes, Docker).

  • Experience supporting federal ATO/RMF processes and providing infrastructure artifacts (SSP, POA&M, scan results).

  • Experience with Oracle Cloud technologies such as OIC and OCI in HCM or ERP contexts.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$105,100-$231,100

jobs.excerpt: About the ClientWe’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.
jobs.description:
About the Client

We’re helping a boutique professional services and advisory firm based in Nassau, The Bahamas find a Financial Analyst to support its growing portfolio of clients.

The firm works with entrepreneurs, established businesses, institutions, and international clients across strategic and financial advisory, corporate services, accounting and bookkeeping, back-office administration, and project management. Its clients span a variety of industries, including healthcare, professional services, government, and other service-based businesses.

The Role

We’re looking for a Financial Analyst – Accounting & Advisory to support the financial reporting, analysis, and research that underpin the firm's strategic advisory work.

The role sits at the intersection of accounting operations, financial analysis, and advisory support. You’ll work across multiple client businesses, preparing and analyzing P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, monthly financial packs, and straightforward forecasts while ensuring the senior advisory team has accurate and well-structured financial information to work from.

This is not primarily a valuation or complex financial modeling role. Instead, you'll develop a strong understanding of the financial operations of different businesses and turn their numbers into useful insights and structured outputs that support strategic decision-making.

There may also be research, commercial analysis, and project work depending on the needs of each client. As you develop, there is an opportunity to become increasingly involved in the strategic advisory side of the business.

Role Details

Commitment: Full-Time (40 hours/week)

Working Hours: Bahamas working hours

Location: Fully Remote

Engagement: Independent Contractor

Start Date: ASAP

Monthly Rate: $1,800-$2,400 (can be higher, depending on level of experience)

What You’ll Do

Financial Reporting & Accounting Support

  • Prepare and maintain P&Ls, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other financial reports across multiple client accounts.

  • Prepare recurring monthly financial and management reporting packs using established templates and processes.

  • Review and organize financial information to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

  • Analyze financial performance and identify relevant trends, movements, discrepancies, and areas requiring attention.

  • Support the financial back-office requirements of non-finance businesses across different industries.

  • Maintain well-organized financial information and supporting documentation across client accounts.

  • Learn and work with client-specific accounting systems, processes, and proprietary software where required.

Forecasting & Financial Analysis

  • Prepare and maintain straightforward financial forecasts and projections.

  • Support cash flow planning and other forward-looking financial analysis.

  • Analyze historical and current financial performance to help inform business decisions.

  • Assist with financial analysis relating to commercial credit, loan financing, and other business requirements where needed.

  • Translate financial data into clear and structured information for senior team members.

  • Flag unusual movements, inconsistencies, or areas that warrant further investigation.

The modeling requirements for this role are relatively straightforward. You won't be expected to build complex valuation or transaction models; the emphasis is on strong financial fundamentals, accurate reporting, practical forecasting, and understanding what the numbers mean for the business.

Strategic Advisory & Research Support

  • Prepare financial information and analysis used by senior team members in client-facing strategic advisory work.

  • Conduct business, financial, market, or industry research where required for client assignments.

  • Gather and structure information needed to support strategic recommendations.

  • Help turn financial and research findings into clear reports, presentations, and other client-facing materials.

  • Support senior team members with ad hoc analysis for different business challenges and opportunities.

  • Develop an understanding of each client's business model, operations, and commercial environment rather than looking at financial information in isolation.

Client & Project Support

  • Work across multiple client accounts and adapt to different industries, business models, and reporting requirements.

  • Support project coordination, documentation, and follow-up across advisory engagements.

  • Manage recurring deliverables and ensure financial information is prepared accurately and on time.

  • Assist with broader analytical and administrative requirements connected to client projects.

  • Take increasing ownership of client work as your understanding and capabilities develop.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Haves

  • Ideally 3–5 years of relevant experience in financial analysis, accounting, FP&A, management reporting, corporate services, or a similar finance-focused environment. However, practical capability is more important to us than a specific number of years.

  • Academic background in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related field.

  • Strong understanding of P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flow statements and how they work together.

  • Hands-on experience preparing and analyzing financial reports and management information.

  • Comfortable preparing straightforward forecasts and financial projections.

  • Strong numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

  • Strong spreadsheet skills and confidence working with financial data.

  • Excellent attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.

  • Ability to identify trends, inconsistencies, and relevant insights from financial information.

  • Ability to work across multiple clients, assignments, and deadlines.

  • Strong organizational skills and ability to learn new systems and processes quickly.

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently, take ownership of deliverables, and recognize when issues need to be escalated.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in professional services, corporate consultancy, accounting, FP&A, or financial advisory.

  • Experience supporting multiple external client accounts.

  • Experience working with SMEs or service-based businesses.

  • Exposure to healthcare, medical, dental, government, or other professional-services clients.

  • Understanding of commercial lending, loan financing, or credit analysis.

  • Experience preparing management reports and financial projections.

  • Previous exposure to strategic advisory or consulting projects.

  • Experience conducting business, market, or industry research.

  • Experience managing or supporting financial back-office operations for non-finance businesses.

  • Experience working across multiple industries.

Ideal Candidate Profile

You’re someone who is strong with numbers but also interested in the business behind them.

You can confidently work with P&Ls, balance sheets, and cash flows, prepare reliable financial reporting, maintain forecasts, and spot when something doesn’t look right. At the same time, you’re curious about why the numbers are moving and what they mean for the business.

You may come from accounting, FP&A, financial analysis, consulting, or even a more traditional financial analyst background. What matters most is that you're comfortable with the practical financial work involved and genuinely interested in supporting businesses across a range of financial and strategic challenges.

This could also be a good fit for someone with a more modeling- or transaction-oriented finance background who is looking to move into a role with less emphasis on complex modeling and transactions and greater exposure to ongoing business operations and strategic advisory.

You’re organized, adaptable, commercially curious, and comfortable switching between financial reporting, forecasting, research, and project work across different client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a reliable extension of the advisory team who can independently manage high-quality financial preparation and analysis across multiple clients.

You’ll progressively reduce the financial preparation required from senior team members by ensuring reports, financial packs, forecasts, research, and supporting information are accurate, well-structured, and ready for use in strategic discussions.

As your understanding of the clients and advisory work develops, there will be opportunities to take on greater responsibility across financial analysis, research, strategic advisory, and project support.

Why Join?

  • Gain exposure to the financial operations and strategic challenges of multiple businesses and industries.

  • Work closely with experienced professionals on real-world client advisory engagements.

  • Build experience beyond traditional accounting or financial reporting into research and strategic advisory.

  • Take meaningful ownership of client work rather than being limited to one narrow finance function.

  • Develop a broader understanding of how financial information supports business strategy and decision-making.

  • Opportunity to grow into greater advisory and project responsibilities over time.

  • Join a fully remote team with a long-term opportunity for professional development.

Recruitment Process

  1. Initial Interview with Bamboo Works

  2. Client Interview

  3. Practical Financial Assessment for Finalists

  4. Offer & Onboarding

The practical assessment will take place after the client interview stage and will only be completed by final shortlisted candidates.

Tests are written before or alongside implementation

Pull requests are small, reviewed quickly, and merged to main frequently

jobs.description:
Bitrefill is remote-first. This is full-time. You'll need solid overlap with both European and Latin American time zones.

What is Bitrefill?

Bitrefill lets people spend crypto on real stuff: gift cards, mobile top-ups, subscriptions, bill payments. 180+ countries. Profitable since launch. Over 12 years in and still building.

The team is about 90 people, fully distributed. Product decisions are made close to the work. The role sits within a focused squad of 5-7 people: engineers and designers who take pride in what they ship. Few meetings. Lots of autonomy.

The job

Bitrefill's early product decisions came from people who live on crypto themselves. That intuition built the foundation, but the company has reached a scale where intuition alone is not enough. This role is about turning scattered knowledge of crypto-native users into a systematic product strategy.

The market is also shifting. DeFi users are moving from speculation toward investing. Yield positions, airdrop proceeds, stablecoin salaries: real wealth that people want to use without friction. Bitrefill needs a product manager who understands this transition and can build for it.

THE HARD PROBLEMS

This role exists because these challenges, and many more, remain open:

  • Users hold assets across Arbitrum, Base, Solana, and elsewhere. Checkout needs to feel simple without obscuringthe complexity that actually matters.

  • WalletConnect sessions drop, signing flows vary across wallets, and mobile browser behavior is inconsistent. A payment experience that works reliably across these conditions does not yet exist.

  • When someone claims an airdrop or exits a lending position, they have liquidity. Reaching them at the right moment, without being intrusive, is an unsolved design problem.

  • High-value users transact thousands per month. A $2,000 gift card purchase requires confidence that the system will work. That trust must be built into the product itself.

What you'll do

  • Own product discovery, planning, and delivery for crypto-native features

  • Conduct direct research with users who spend crypto daily: understand their setups, workarounds, and frustrations

  • Write specifications with clear requirements and acceptance criteria; manage the backlog; ship end-to-end alongside engineering and design

  • Make integration decisions about chains, wallets, and protocols, based on usage data rather than market hype

  • Facilitate cross-functional coordination with compliance, marketing, support, and operations

  • Represent Bitrefill in crypto communities and at industry conferences

Who you are

Experience

  • 8+ years in product management, ideally in payments, e-commerce, or fintech

  • Track record of shipping products with real adoption

  • Experience leading work across distributed teams and time zones

  • Practical experience with DeFi: vaults, collateralized positions, bridging, gas dynamics

  • Familiarity with wallet UX across desktop and mobile

  • Ability to decompose large problems into shippable increments

  • Skill in facilitating alignment across engineering, design, and business functions

  • Clear written communication: specifications, decision documents, async updates

Working with AI

  • AI is already part of the workflow: drafting specifications, building quick prototypes, improving written communication

  • Able to close the gap between product thinking and technical implementation

  • Self-directed use, not waiting for an AI strategy to be handed down

Mindset

  • Skepticism toward hype, curiosity toward actual usage patterns

  • Preference for shipping small things that work over large things that do not

  • Comfort with ambiguity, paired with the ability to create clarity for others

Why Bitrefill?

We've been making crypto actually useful since 2014. Remote-first before it was cool. You get real ownership, real trust, and a team that ships.

The work is challenging. The people are sharp and creative. There's always someone to bounce ideas off, plus regular gatherings, meetups, and conferences to stay connected beyond the screen.

If you're wondering whether this is for you:

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM Functional Consultant with extensive federal Human Capital Management experience to provide functional design leadership on a large‑scale HCM modernization program for a federal civilian agency. The program is migrating legacy HR systems to Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.

This role offers the opportunity to shape the functional solution for an enterprise SaaS ERP implementation in an Agile delivery environment, supporting HR service delivery across the federal workforce. You will serve as the functional design authority for one or more Oracle Fusion HCM domains, act as a subject matter expert on federal HR policy, and lead design activities across multiple integrated modules.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as functional design authority for one or more Oracle Fusion HCM domains, owning design decisions from requirements through go‑live.

  • Lead requirements and design workshops with agency HR leaders and subject matter experts; drive consensus where stakeholders diverge.

  • Own fit‑gap analysis and disposition decisions—determining whether needs are met via configuration, extension, integration, or business process changes—and present recommendations to government stakeholders.

  • Interpret federal HR policy (Title 5, Title 38, GPPA, OPM regulations) and act as the escalation point for policy questions impacting system design.

  • Establish configuration standards and design patterns; review and approve configuration delivered by other consultants.

  • Direct the design of federal benefits programs including FEHB, FEDVIP, FERS, CSRS, TSP, and FEGLI.

  • Direct the design of federal pay structures including GS, SES, Wage Grade, Title 38 pay plans, locality pay, and special salary rates.

  • Direct absence and time design including leave accruals, FMLA, military leave, compensatory time, credit hours, AWS, premium pay, and FLSA determinations.

  • Own personnel action processing design including position management, actions and reasons, Nature of Action codes, and SF‑50/SF‑52 workflows.

  • Define Oracle Application Security architecture including Job, Data, and Duty roles; privileges; data security profiles; and segregation‑of‑duties requirements.

  • Own data conversion strategy including mapping standards, sequencing, validation criteria, user acceptance thresholds, and defect adjudication.

  • Define functional integration requirements for federal systems (EHRI, eOPF, USA Staffing, payroll providers, benefits carriers); resolve design conflicts with technical architects.

  • Approve testing strategy and coverage within your domain; support UAT, parallel payroll validation, and formal test exit activities.

  • Assess quarterly Oracle SaaS release updates for impacts and recommend adoption, deferral, or remediation.

  • Present design decisions, risks, and solution recommendations to government stakeholders, CCBs, and program leadership.

  • Own functional readiness for your domain including cutover planning, Go/No‑Go evidence, post‑go‑live validation, and hypercare resolution.

  • Provide mentoring, technical direction, and deliverable review for functional consultants.

  • Lead Agile ceremonies including PI Planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews; influence release scope and sequencing.


Qualifications:

Required:

  • Must be a U.S. Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance.

  • Bachelor’s degree and 10+ years of relevant experience (additional experience may substitute for degree).

  • Experience completing multiple end‑to‑end HCM lifecycle implementations within U.S. federal agencies, including at least one serving in a design‑leading capacity.

  • 7+ years of hands‑on functional configuration and design experience with enterprise HCM applications. Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM preferred; Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, PeopleSoft, DCPDS, or Oracle EBS HR considered with demonstrated Fusion transition capability.

  • Recognized functional depth across multiple HCM domains: Core HCM, Federal HR, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Time and Labor, Learning.

  • Authoritative knowledge of federal HR regulations and policies, including Title 5 and Title 38 pay authorities, personnel action processing, and federal benefits administration.

  • Experience owning and defending functional design decisions to government stakeholders and review boards.

  • Experience across requirements analysis, data migration, testing, training, deployment readiness, and post‑production support.

  • Demonstrated ability to mentor and guide functional consultants.

  • Strong analytical skills with ability to translate complex policy requirements into enterprise system design.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills including experience briefing senior federal officials.

Desired:

  • Extensive hands‑on Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM configuration experience.

  • Oracle HCM Cloud certification in one or more functional domains.

  • Deep experience with major federal HR programs (FEHB, FEDVIP, FERS, CSRS, TSP, FEGLI) and federal pay systems (GS, SES, Wage Grade).

  • Extensive experience with SF‑50 processing, Nature of Action coding, GPPA requirements, and OPM reporting.

  • Experience with federal HR legacy systems (DCPDS, EmpowHR) as migration sources.

  • Proficiency with Oracle tools: FSM, HDL/HSDL, HCM Extracts, OTBI, BI Publisher, Fast Formula, Security Console.

  • Experience defining enterprise‑scale Oracle Fusion security role architectures.

  • Experience managing quarterly SaaS update strategies across large configured deployments.

  • Advanced Agile certification (SAFe Agilist, SAFe Architect, etc.).

  • Prior experience supporting federal civilian or DoD HCM modernization programs.

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.

This position is contingent on funding and may not be filled immediately. However, this position is representative of positions within CACI that are consistently available. Individuals who apply may also be considered for other positions at CACI.

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

$105,100-$231,100

jobs.title: Junior UX/UI Designer (AI-Native Process)
jobs.excerpt: About UsFlying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East.
jobs.description:
About Us

Flying Bisons is a leading Strategic Design & Digital Consulting company based in Warsaw, with projects across Europe and the Middle East. Our mission is to help our clients Unleash Digital Potential™.

We work at scales where real impact happens: enterprise platforms, government services, and corporate ecosystems used by millions of people. Our projects include national workforce platforms (Qiwa, Ajeer), education ecosystems (Madares), major banks (Bank Pekao, Alinma), global telecoms (Ooredoo, Salam), and international brands (KFC, Hebe, NaTemat, Enel-Med).

Our uniqueness comes from going beyond design craft. As we wrote in our manifestos - Strategic Design - Manifest and Strategic Design - The Future of Design - design craft is only 10% of success. The other 90% - the Invisible 90% - is about navigating politics, aligning stakeholders, and protecting fragile visions until they reach reality.

That’s why we’re building the discipline of Strategic Design - and we want you to be part of it.

Role context

We are looking for an ambitious Junior or early Mid-level Designer who wants to grow in an AI-native environment.

You do not need to be an AI expert.

You do not need to know how to code.

And you do not need several years of commercial experience.

What matters much more to us is whether you are curious, willing to experiment, quick to learn and already trying to use AI as part of your design process.

Maybe you have already tested Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude or another similar tool.

Maybe you have built a small app, prototype, landing page or personal project.

Or maybe you are simply the kind of person who sees a new tool and immediately wants to find out what can be done with it.

That is the mindset we are looking for.

At Flying Bisons, you will work alongside more experienced UX, UI and Strategic Designers and learn how to turn briefs, ideas and user needs into interactive solutions.

The goal is not to replace design fundamentals with AI.

The goal is to use AI to design faster, smarter and better.

Scope of services

  • work in project teams alongside more experienced UX, UI and Strategic Designers,

  • help translate briefs, concepts and user needs into user flows and interactive prototypes,

  • use AI to quickly explore different solutions instead of designing every screen from scratch,

  • experiment with tools such as Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude Code and new solutions emerging on the market,

  • create early versions of flows that can quickly be clicked through, discussed and developed further,

  • iterate on solutions based on feedback from more experienced designers and the project team,

  • think about how the whole product behaves, not just about individual screens,

  • consider different states, errors, user actions and edge cases,

  • work in Figma when it is the best tool for the job,

  • develop your ability to combine AI with solid UX and UI fundamentals,

  • gradually build your own AI-native workflow,

  • share interesting tools, experiments and learnings with the team.

    Over time, we want you to become increasingly independent in taking a well-defined product problem and turning it into a solid interactive solution.

What we are looking for

We are looking for someone who:

  • has some practical experience with UX/UI or Product Design, gained through commercial work, internships, freelance work, university projects or personal projects,

  • understands basic UX principles and can think about the entire user flow rather than individual screens,

  • has a good visual sense and understands the basics of hierarchy, spacing and interface design,

  • actively looks for ways to use AI to improve or speed up their design process

  • is interested in how AI is changing design and wants to actively develop in this area,

  • is comfortable trying new things even when they do not initially know exactly how to approach them,

  • learns new tools quickly,

  • is open to feedback and comfortable showing work that is still in progress,

  • can explain the reasoning behind their design decisions,

  • thinks not only about how a button looks, but also about what happens after the user clicks it,

  • can communicate comfortably in English in a project environment.

    You do not need to meet every requirement perfectly.

    If you are at the beginning of your career but already experimenting, building your own things and learning quickly, we would still be very happy to hear from you.

Nice to have

  • built a prototype, small app, website or personal project using AI,

  • experience with tools such as Lovable, v0, Bolt, Figma Make, Cursor, Claude Code or similar,

  • basic knowledge of how websites and digital products are built,

  • basic knowledge of HTML, CSS or general front-end concepts,

  • experience working with developers, Product Managers or researchers,

  • personal projects that demonstrate curiosity and initiative beyond work or university,

  • experience experimenting with different AI models and tools.

    None of these are mandatory.

What matters more than years of experience

We are not looking for the person with the longest CV.

We are looking for signs of potential.

What matters most to us is:

  • curiosity,

  • learning speed,

  • product thinking,

  • initiative,

  • willingness to experiment,

  • solid design fundamentals,

  • genuine interest in AI-native design.

A small project that you built yourself and can explain well may tell us more about you than a perfectly polished portfolio.

Short video application

Instead of a traditional cover letter, we would like you to send us a short video in English.

Maximum length: 8-10 minutes.

You do not need to prepare or edit it professionally. A simple screen recording or Loom is absolutely fine.

We would like you to show us two things.

1. Show us something you created, around 5 minutes

Show us one project or experiment where you used AI.

It can be:

  • a prototype,

  • a small app,

  • a website,

  • a university project,

  • a personal project,

  • an experiment,

  • or something you created mainly to learn a new tool.

Briefly tell us:

  • What were you trying to create?

  • Which AI tool did you use?

  • What did AI help you with?

  • What did you change or design yourself?

  • What did you learn while working on it?

The project does not need to be commercial or particularly complex.

We are much more interested in how you approached it.

2. Tell us what you are learning now, around 3 to 5 minutes

Tell us:

What AI tool, workflow or capability are you currently exploring? Show or tell us what caught your attention and what you would like to be able to do with it.

There is no single correct answer.

We simply want to understand what interests you and how you approach learning new things.

A few important things:

  • You do not need professional equipment.

  • You do not need to edit your recording.

  • You do not need a commercial AI project.

  • Please do not show any confidential client materials.

  • You do not need to prepare a presentation.

  • If your project is small, that is absolutely fine.

Show us something real and tell us about it in your own words.

Recruitment process

We want to keep the process simple and straightforward.

Step 1: Short video

You send us your CV, portfolio and the short video described above.

Step 2: HR screening

Around 30 minutes.

Step 3: Design interview

Around 45 minutes with one of our designers.

Optional: Short practical task

In some cases, we may ask you to complete a short practical task if we need one additional data point before making a decision.

Cooperation terms

  • B2B cooperation or umowa zlecenie for candidates with student status

  • remote cooperation.

  • work in an Apple and Google Workspace-based environment,

  • access to selected tools, systems and project environments required for project delivery,

  • opportunity to work with experienced specialists across strategy, design, research, product, analytics, technology and delivery,

  • cooperation based on delivery quality, agreed outcomes and clear communication.

Power Digital is an AI-Native Growth Firm built at the intersection of world-class talent and proprietary technology. We help leading and emerging brands grow by combining deep vertical expertise, strategic thinking, and enterprise intelligence to drive measurable business outcomes.

For more than a decade, we have built our business around one belief: the best technology makes great people better. Our teams of strategists, creatives, analysts, and technologists use Omega, our AI operating system, to surface opportunities faster, investigate what is driving performance, and execute approved work with greater speed and precision. Behind Omega is Iris, our proprietary intelligence layer, built on years of real performance data, strategic frameworks, testing, and learnings from across our client portfolio. AI expands the capacity of our people to think, create, solve harder problems, and make better decisions. Human judgment, creativity, and accountability remain central to how we work.

As a people-first firm, we value diversity in backgrounds and experiences. We strongly believe our people and culture are key to our success. We partner closely with our clients as an extension of their teams, working across strategy, execution, and measurement to identify what is truly blocking growth and determine what to do next. Our culture is built on people who are curious, ambitious, accountable, and committed to delivering meaningful results for our clients and for one another.

At Power Digital, we believe the future belongs to teams that combine the best talent with the best technology. We are building that future today.

Your qualifications will be assessed for both present positions and future opportunities. Should your skills align with a role and an opening arise, our recruitment team will reach out to you promptly. However, please keep in mind that this doesn't guarantee immediate placement or communication.

A day in the life:

  • The Social Strategist is responsible for crafting and executing comprehensive social media strategies for clients across diverse industries. This role involves developing unique brand voices, managing influencer relationships, and overseeing A-Z content creation and execution. As a highly autonomous and creative team member, the Social Strategist navigates a fast-paced workload, actively participates in team collaboration, and remains at the forefront of industry trends to consistently drive innovative and impactful social media campaigns for clients

Responsibilities:

  • Social Strategy Development: Create and execute comprehensive social media campaign strategies tailored to each client's goals and target audience, including influencer relationships
  • Influencer Programming Strategy & Production: Proficient in strategically driving influencer programming through identifying, vetting and slating influencer talent and creators for campaigns. This is inclusive of negotiating, communicating deliverables, seeing partnership through from execution to completion, and reporting on performance
  • Autonomous Workflow Management: Efficiently manage a dynamic workload, working independently to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines for multiple client accounts
  • Creative Strategy Development: Craft compelling and on-brand copy and creative for social media posts and influencer campaign plans and briefs, utilizing past months performance to drive strategic changes while incorporating trend-driven and relevant social context
  • Social Content Execution: Create and implement monthly content calendars that align with the overall social media strategy, ensuring consistent posting schedules and content themes for client accounts
  • Trendspotting: Stay up-to-date with the latest social media trends, emerging platforms, and algorithm changes, actively bringing fresh ideas and strategies to the team
  • Collaborative Team Meetings: Actively participate in team meetings, contributing creative insights, sharing industry updates, and collaborating on cross-functional initiatives
  • Client Communication: Maintain clear and effective communication with clients, providing regular updates on campaign progress, results, and recommendations for improvement
  • Employ AI technologies to enhance and optimize business processes
  • Utilize and leverage Power Digital's Nova ecosystem as it relates to your department

Role Requirements:

  • 2+ years of experience in social media (agency experience preferred)
  • Industry Expertise: Proactive in staying current with the latest trends, algorithm changes, and platform updates in the social media landscape, must have examples of applying this knowledge to enhance strategies
  • Client Variety: Proven track record of successfully managing social media strategies for multiple clients spanning various industries, demonstrating adaptability and versatility
  • Brand Voice & Tone: Experience in crafting and maintaining unique brand voices for clients, ensuring consistency and authenticity in all social media content
  • Results and Impact: Proven history of developing and managing social campaigns that drove impactful results across a variety of KPIs; proficiency in leveraging data and analytics to refine and optimize social strategies for maximum impact

  • Established goals/targets for 100% of accounts
  • Hitting within 15% of target forecast OR having key recommendations in place to hit goals
  • Below 10% Client Churn Rate
  • Understands all strategies of department and can execute on 100% Can navigate 100%+ difficult probing questions on performance

Most Important Things (MITs)

  • Client Performance and Sentiment
  • Autonomous workflow management and account ownership
  • Department Support

jobs.description:
Precision for Medicine is hiring a Senior Manager, Clinical Operations to join our team. Candidates can work remotely in the UK, Hungary, Poland, Romania, Serbia or Slovakia.

Position Summary:

The Senior Manager, Clinical Operations – Clinical Process Owner is responsible for leading the governance, harmonization, and continuous improvement of Clinical Operations processes across the organization. The role owns the development, simplification, alignment, and lifecycle management of Clinical Operations SOPs, work instructions, tools, templates, and related process documentation. Working cross-functionally and across regions, the role ensures that processes are compliant, practical, scalable, and consistently applied. As a senior Clinical Operations SME, the role also supports audits, inspections, CAPAs, strategic initiatives, and business development activities where Clinical Operations process expertise is required. This is an individual contributor leadership role requiring influence across functions, regions, and seniority levels. The role may lead cross-functional working groups, process teams, and strategic improvement initiatives.

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Serve as the Clinical Process Owner for Clinical Operations processes, ensuring effective governance, clear accountability, lifecycle management, and alignment across regions and functions.
  • Lead the development, review, harmonization, implementation, and maintenance of Clinical Operations SOPs, work instructions, tools, templates, and related documentation.
  • Identify and resolve process gaps, duplication, inconsistencies, conflicting requirements, and unnecessary complexity to establish clear, practical, and scalable ways of working.
  • Translate regulatory requirements, ICH-GCP principles, quality standards, audit and inspection findings, CAPAs, operational data, and stakeholder feedback into effective process solutions.
  • Lead and represent cross-functional process governance and decision-making, partnering with Clinical Operations, Quality Assurance, Regulatory, Project Management, Data Management, Biostatistics, Medical, Training, and other relevant functions.
  • Lead process implementation and change management, including impact assessment, stakeholder engagement, training and communication requirements, adoption monitoring, and evaluation of process effectiveness.
  • Act as a senior Clinical Operations SME for strategic initiatives, audits, inspections, CAPAs, process assessments, operational improvement activities, and business development support, as required, including including providing Clinical Operations input for proposals, budgets, contracts, and bid defense meetings, and representing Clinical Operations process capabilities, delivery models, and operational strengths to prospective clients.

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, healthcare, clinical research, business, or a related field; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • At least 5+ years of progressive clinical research or clinical operations experience in a CRO, pharmaceutical, biotechnology, or global clinical outsourcing environment.
  • Proven experience leading complex cross-functional or global process improvement initiatives from assessment and design through implementation and effectiveness evaluation within a CRO environment.
  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial operations, clinical monitoring, site management, and cross-functional trial delivery processes.
  • Strong knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory expectations, quality standards, and inspection readiness principles.

Preferred:

  • Experience with process mapping, change management, Lean, or continuous improvement methodologies.
  • Expert understanding of Clinical Operations processes and their cross-functional interfaces.
  • Ability to interpret regulatory and quality requirements and translate them into clear, proportionate, and operationally practical processes.
Precision for Medicine is the first global precision medicine clinical research services organization, purpose-built to improve the clinical research and development process for new therapeutics. Our novel approach integrates clinical operations excellence, with laboratory expertise, and advanced data sciences to inform every step. We apply our expertise to trials at all stages—from early development through approval—with embedded experience in oncology and rare disease.

    • numbers, dates, times, and currencies;
    • abbreviations and other text normalization rules.
    • Ensure that the original words and meaning have been preserved.
    • Identify and correct formatting or guideline-related errors.
    • Use the reference audio when necessary to verify ambiguous cases.
    • Apply project-specific quality standards consistently.

Plooto is a payment automation platform built to help accountants, bookkeepers, and their clients take control of their payables and receivables. About the Role

Plooto is looking for a Manager, Cross-Border & FX Payments to lead the execution and growth of our cross-border payments and foreign exchange business.

Cross-border payments and FX represent a significant growth opportunity for Plooto and are an important part of our strategy to grow sustainable, non-float payment revenue. We have established the strategic direction; this role will provide the dedicated ownership required to turn that strategy into measurable customer and business outcomes.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with meaningful business-line ownership. You will bring together Product, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, Risk & Compliance, and external payment partners around a shared plan and measurable outcomes. You will not directly manage every team responsible for delivery, so success requires strong influence, commercial judgment, analytical depth, and the ability to drive execution across organizational boundaries.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own execution of Plooto’s Cross-Border & FX strategy, translating strategic priorities into clear initiatives, roadmaps, KPIs, and measurable business outcomes. Drive growth in FX revenue, cross-border payment volume, customer penetration, repeat usage, and revenue per customer, while identifying opportunities to expand corridors, currencies, payment methods, and customer use cases.
  • Drive commercialization and customer adoption by developing initiatives that increase awareness, penetration, and repeat usage of Plooto’s cross-border and FX capabilities. Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on customer segmentation, positioning, demand generation, expansion opportunities, and the cross-border value proposition for prospective and existing customers.
  • Own and continuously improve FX pricing and economics, balancing customer competitiveness, adoption, revenue growth, and margin. Analyze FX spreads, transaction economics, customer price sensitivity, competitive positioning, and corridor-level performance, and identify opportunities to improve unit economics through pricing optimization, liquidity strategy, wholesale FX procurement, partner economics, and other mechanisms as the business scales.
  • Shape the Cross-Border & FX product roadmap as the payments subject-matter expert, partnering closely with Product and Engineering to identify and prioritize opportunities based on customer needs, commercial impact, operational efficiency, and strategic value. Develop business cases and requirements and support new capabilities from concept through launch, commercialization, and adoption.
  • Manage key banking, FX, and cross-border payment partnerships in partnership with the Head of Payments Strategy & Compliance. Own partner performance, economics, service levels, capabilities, and roadmap discussions, while evaluating new partners and infrastructure that can improve coverage, customer experience, economics, or resiliency.
  • Lead complex cross-functional execution across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Operations, Risk, and Compliance. Create alignment around priorities, dependencies, timelines, and outcomes, independently moving initiatives from strategy through implementation and influencing teams and senior stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Use data and customer insight to continuously improve business performance, analyzing customer behaviour, payment patterns, product performance, and market trends to identify opportunities, develop business cases, inform investment decisions, and provide senior leadership with clear performance updates, recommendations, and decision points.
  • Partner with Risk and Compliance to appropriately manage regulatory and operational considerations, ensuring new products, corridors, partnerships, and commercialization strategies reflect applicable AML/ATF, sanctions, payments, financial, and operational requirements while balancing customer experience and growth objectives.

Qualifications

  • Significant experience in cross-border payments, foreign exchange, treasury, transaction banking, fintech, or payment infrastructure.
  • Deep understanding of how international payments move, including correspondent banking, payment networks, settlement, liquidity, and FX conversion, along with strong knowledge of FX pricing, spreads, wholesale currency procurement, liquidity management, and hedging concepts.
  • Experience developing, scaling, or commercializing payments or FX products, ideally within a fintech, payments company, bank, or SMB-focused platform.
  • Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with experience owning revenue targets, business performance, product economics, or a P&L and using data to identify opportunities, develop business cases, prioritize investments, and measure results.
  • Experience partnering closely with Product and Engineering teams to influence roadmaps and bring payment capabilities to market.
  • Experience managing banking, payment network, FX provider, or other strategic financial-services partnerships, including evaluating partner performance and economics.
  • Strong understanding of the regulatory and risk considerations associated with cross-border payments.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence senior stakeholders without direct authority, move comfortably between strategy and detailed execution, and simplify complex payment concepts for technical, commercial, and executive audiences.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We’re transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience to solve a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

The biggest reason small businesses fail is poor financial management and cash flow — and Plooto fixes that. We have strong product-market fit, a massive opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You’ll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in our craft, and moves with urgency. We’re just getting started — and you’ll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Materials Science Expert

Pay: $80–$130/hour

Location: Global, fully remote

Job Type: Contractor (~15 hours per week)
