jobs.title: Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy
jobs.excerpt: The Proportional Representation HubAmerican democracy is at a breaking point.
jobs.description:
The Proportional Representation Hub

American democracy is at a breaking point. Across the country, voters increasingly find themselves throwing up their hands and turning away from a failing political system. Hyper-partisanship has become entrenched. Fewer than one in ten House races is competitive, and 97% of incumbents cruise to reelection: for most voters, the outcome was settled before a single ballot was cast. Little wonder that politicians feel little pressure to deliver legislative results. Public trust in democratic institutions continues to erode as more and more voters tune out.

But the problem isn’t the politicians. It’s the rules. U.S. elections are distorted by single-winner, winner-take-all districts. A party can win 45% of the vote in districts across a state yet it wins no power. The Supreme Court’s evisceration of the Voting Rights Act has made things much worse: voters in communities of color are being carved up and packed into districts engineered to drown out their voices, and the court has triggered a redistricting death spiral. The need for structural reform has never been more urgent.

There is a fix, and most of the world already uses it: proportional representation. The idea is simple––districts elect several members, and a party that wins a third of the votes wins about a third of the seats. It breaks the two-party monopoly, makes every district competitive, eliminates partisan gerrymandering, and reduces polarization.

The Proportional Representation Hub has launched to help build the next chapter of American democracy. We have raised more than $70 million to lead a campaign to advance proportional representation at the local, state, and federal levels and build a government that delivers again. Proportional representation is the best path to create a democracy that better reflects the diversity of the American people, and the best path to end the redistricting wars.

This work is ambitious: forging unlikely coalitions, winning new legislation and ballot measures, changing public narratives, and developing innovative political strategies. Above all, it demands a cross-partisan movement big enough to persuade the huge majority of Americans who say the political system no longer works for them that our democracy can work far better than it does today.

We are building a team of exceptional leaders working together to reshape the architecture of American democracy itself.

Position Overview

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will build and lead the communications, research, and narrative infrastructure necessary to make proportional representation one of the defining democracy reform movements of the 21st century.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will lead all communications, narrative development, public opinion research, digital engagement, media relations, and strategic communications efforts for the Proportional Representation Hub.

This executive will be responsible for shaping how policymakers, voters, journalists, funders, advocates, and opinion leaders understand proportional representation, in the context of other democracy reforms. They will oversee the communications strategies supporting federal, state, and local campaigns while simultaneously building a long-term narrative change effort to help transform the national conversation about democracy and move the idea of proportional representation from the margins to the mainstream.

The Vice President will oversee communications consultants, research firms, polling vendors, creative agencies, digital partners, media strategists, and public affairs consultants. They will also help build communications capacity throughout the broader democracy reform ecosystem, providing strategic guidance and technical support to allied organizations and campaign partners.

The Vice President of Communications and Narrative Strategy will serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team.

This is a role for a visionary strategist, storyteller, communicator, and movement builder who understands that political change begins with narrative change.

What You’ll Lead

Build a Narrative for Democratic Reform and a Message for Proportional Representation

  • Develop and execute a long-term narrative strategy for multiparty electoral reform and redefine the public conversation about representation, accountability, fairness, and democratic legitimacy.
  • Create messaging frameworks that make proportional representation understandable, compelling, and that resonate across ideological, geographic, racial, and generational divides. Translate complex policy reforms into accessible, motivating narratives that inspire action and support. Ensure campaign communications consistently advance both immediate policy goals and long-term narrative and movement-building objectives.

Lead Narrative Intelligence and Opposition Analysis

  • Build a narrative intelligence operation that continuously tracks public opinion, media narratives, opposition messaging, cultural trends, and emerging political opportunities.
  • Identify threats, attacks, misinformation campaigns, and opposition arguments before they become obstacles to campaign success, and develop proactive communications strategies that inoculate target audiences against predictable attacks and mischaracterizations.
  • Lead ongoing analysis of the political, media, and advocacy landscape to identify opportunities to expand support for proportional representation.
  • Serve as a strategic advisor to the Executive Director and leadership team on reputational risks, emerging opportunities, and changing political conditions.

Drive Winning Campaign Communications

  • Lead communications strategy for federal, state, and local campaigns across the organization’s portfolio.
  • Develop integrated communications plans that leverage earned media, paid media, digital engagement, thought leadership, coalition communications, grassroots storytelling, and public affairs strategies.
  • Ensure campaigns have compelling messaging, rapid response capabilities, media strategies, research support, and public engagement plans.
  • Provide communications strategy, message guidance, narrative support, and technical assistance to allied organizations and coalition partners to support thought leadership across the movement. Create shared tools, research products, messaging resources, narrative frameworks, and strategic guidance that can be deployed by partners nationwide.
  • Build and train a bench of spokespeople and champions for proportional representation, diverse across multiple dimensions including ideologically, and place their voices in traditional and new media channels.
  • Build strong relationships with journalists, editorial boards, influencers, content creators, podcast hosts, and opinion leaders.

Oversee Research and Message Development

  • Lead all public opinion research with polling, focus groups, message testing, audience segmentation, narrative research, and voter insight efforts.
  • Work with leading research firms and strategists to deepen understanding of voter attitudes toward democracy, representation, and political reform.
  • Build systems that allow successful innovations and lessons learned in one campaign to strengthen efforts across the broader movement.

Build a Modern Digital and Media Program

  • Oversee all digital communications, content strategy, social media, paid media, influencer engagement, online organizing, audience growth efforts, and emerging communications platforms.
  • Develop innovative approaches to reach audiences beyond traditional political and advocacy channels.
  • Build a modern communications infrastructure capable of supporting persuasion, movement-building, and rapid-response objectives across federal, state, and local campaigns.

Who you are

You bring a proven track record of leading large-scale communications, public affairs, political, advocacy, or movement-building efforts that have shifted public opinion, shaped public narratives, and contributed to significant policy victories. You have demonstrated experience thinking strategically about the right messengers to the right audiences in the right channels.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of senior leadership experience in political communications, public affairs, advocacy, movement-building, media, narrative strategy, or related fields.
  • Demonstrated success leading communications efforts that shifted public opinion, shaped public narratives, influenced policymakers, or contributed to significant policy victories.
  • Deep expertise in message development, polling, audience research, media relations, digital communications, public affairs, and strategic communications planning.
  • Experience overseeing communications for complex, multi-state, national, or international campaigns.
  • Strong understanding of how narrative change contributes to long-term political and social change.
  • Experience managing communications firms, polling vendors, research partners, creative agencies, and large communications budgets.
  • Exceptional writing, storytelling, presentation, and strategic thinking skills.
  • Familiarity with campaign finance regulations (C3/C4 compliance).
  • Strong relationships within national media, digital media, political communications, philanthropy, or advocacy ecosystems.
  • Experience building and managing high-performing teams.
  • A deep commitment to strengthening American democracy and advancing representative government.

We are building foundational infrastructure intended to support long-lived, global-scale systems — not short-term SaaS experiments.

This role is for someone who wants to contribute to systems that will matter over time.

Company Stage & Visibility

Coherence OS is in its earliest build phase. We are intentionally operating with a minimal public footprint while core systems, filings, and internal foundations are being finalized.

We have a minimal public website. Full context about the company, mission, and roadmap will be shared during the interview process.

Scope of Work

  • Translate structured system content from English into Portuguese - Brazil
  • Preserve meaning, tone, and conceptual integrity — not just literal phrasing
  • Maintain consistency across terminology and frameworks
  • Flag ambiguities or areas requiring clarification
  • Collaborate asynchronously with our internal team when needed

Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in English (written comprehension required)
  • Ability to translate abstract and conceptual material accurately
  • High attention to detail and consistency
  • Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight

Compensation Options

You may choose between two options:

Option 1: Cash Payment (Project-Based)

  • Fixed, one-time payment upon completion of the translation
  • No ongoing access or involvement beyond the project

Option 2: Platform Access (Preferred Option)

  • 2 years of full platform access (retail value: $4,800+ USD)
  • Access to systems designed to build, operate, and support income-generating activities
  • Removes the need to pay separately for tools, automation, and execution support typically required to run these activities

This option is intended for individuals who think beyond a single project and want access to infrastructure they can continue using over time.

While the retail cost is $4,800+, the actual value is not capped at that number — it depends on how the system is used. Many individuals will spend significantly more than this over time trying to assemble comparable capabilities independently.

Most candidates who recognize the long-term value of access over one-time payment choose Option 2.

Selection Priority

Due to the nature of this work and the role it plays in expanding access globally, priority will be given to candidates who select Platform Access

How to Apply

Please submit:

  • Your CV (in English)
  • A brief note confirming your language pair and availability
  • Which compensation option you prefer

Applications must be submitted in English. Submissions in other languages will not be reviewed.

Closing

This role is best suited for individuals who want to contribute to something being built with long-term intent.

If you are looking for a standard translation task, this will likely feel different.

If you are interested in contributing to systems designed to operate at scale, across languages, and over time — you will likely find this work meaningful.

Join CI Games and be part of shaping the future of gaming. As we embark on an ambitious strategic roadmap with major releases planned for 2026-2028, we're seeking a talented and dedicated Senior Producer to help us create ground-breaking experiences that captivate players worldwide.

Team Leadership & Strategy

  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, establish key milestones, and identify deliverables for assigned teams.

  • Stay agile in your approach, proactively identify project risks, adapt strategies as the landscape shifts, and make rapid decisions that turn obstacles into opportunities.

  • A diverse and inclusive workplace that celebrates all backgrounds, regardless of race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or social status.

  • Company events and wrap-up parties, access to all games released by CI Games and company merchandise.

  • A chance to be part of something ground-breaking as we shape the future of gaming.

Compensation & Pay Transparency

One of CI Games’ Core Values is Equality of Opportunity and we are therefore committed to fair and transparent hiring. Since we hire remote talent across multiple regions, compensation packages are country specific. If your application is shortlisted, we will share the specific salary range for your location with your interview invite, ensuring you have the information you need before we begin formal conversations.

Recruitment Process:

  • Once our Talent Acquisition team receives your application, together with the hiring team, we will review your CV, portfolio and the answers you provided in the application form and if all the boxes are ticked, we're moving to the next stage.

  • Initial call with Talent Acquisition Specialist - During this call you'll learn about the company and we learn about you. We'll talk about your experience & expectations with working in a fully remote environment and we'll talk about your expertise. We'll finish this call with some admin questions. There will be an opportunity for you to ask any questions as well.

  • After the initial call, usually 1 or 2 interviews with the hiring team follows. These interviews will be a bit more technical and will go deeper into your experience, skills & knowledge. As you would have signed an NDA by now, you'll also learn a bit more about the project you would work on. During these interviews we'll also focus on finding out whether you're a good fit for our company culture and that we share the same values.

  • We may or may not ask you to do the test - this is decided on an individual basis and you will receive instructions with the test.

  • If everything goes well, the last step in the recruitment process is the offer presentation call with the Talent Acquisition Specialist and your future line manager to discuss the offer and next steps to get you successfully on board.

We are an equal opportunities employer, hiring and developing our best talent based on merit. Accessibility is at the heart of our games, and we are committed to not discriminating against people based on race, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, or social status. Should you require adjustments or flexible arrangements to interview, or take up a role with us, please let us know in your application and we will accommodate to the best of our ability.

About Eftsure

Eftsure is a fast-scaling SaaS fraud prevention technology company protecting businesses from B2B payment fraud through real-time vendor verification and payment protection.

As cybercrime and payment fraud continue to evolve, Eftsure provides businesses with a critical control designed to help ensure they never pay the wrong people. We are growing globally across the United States, Australia and Europe – and with that growth comes increasing legal, regulatory, risk and governance complexity.

We are now looking for an experienced General Counsel to join our Executive Leadership Team and help protect and enable Eftsure through our next stage of global growth.

About the role

Reporting directly to the CEO, the General Counsel will be Eftsure's senior legal leader globally, responsible for providing strategic legal counsel to the CEO, Board and Executive Leadership Team while overseeing our broader Legal, Risk and Compliance functions.

This is a highly commercial leadership role for someone who can operate comfortably at Board level while remaining close enough to the business to help teams move quickly.

You'll advise across corporate and commercial law, technology and SaaS contracts, privacy and data protection, regulatory compliance, employment matters, intellectual property, M&A and corporate governance. Just as importantly, you'll help Eftsure navigate risk pragmatically – protecting the business without unnecessarily slowing it down.

What you'll be responsible for

  • Act as a trusted legal and strategic advisor to the CEO, Board and Executive Leadership Team.

  • Lead Eftsure's Legal, Risk and Compliance functions across the United States, APAC and Europe.

  • Provide practical commercial advice across corporate and commercial law, technology contracts, partnerships, privacy and data protection, employment law, intellectual property and other matters affecting the business.

  • Review, draft and negotiate complex commercial agreements, including customer, software licensing, vendor, employment and confidentiality agreements.

  • Own Eftsure's approach to legal and regulatory risk, ensuring appropriate frameworks, policies and controls are embedded across the organisation.

  • Keep the Executive Leadership Team and Board ahead of emerging legislation and regulatory developments across the jurisdictions in which Eftsure operates.

  • Lead and support M&A and other corporate transactions, including due diligence, deal structuring and post-transaction integration.

  • Support Board and corporate governance activities, including Board materials, resolutions and corporate secretarial requirements.

  • Oversee data privacy, cybersecurity and broader legal and regulatory compliance.

  • Manage litigation, disputes and claims and oversee relationships with external counsel.

  • Build scalable legal infrastructure, including contract templates, negotiation playbooks, workflows and processes that support Eftsure's continued growth.

What we're looking for

We're looking for an established senior legal leader who combines exceptional legal judgement with strong commercial instincts.

You'll ideally bring:

  • A Juris Doctor (JD), or regional equivalent, from an accredited law school and active membership in good standing with at least one US state bar. California, Texas, New York or Florida admission is preferred.

  • 15+ years' post-qualification legal experience, including significant in-house experience, ideally within SaaS, fintech or technology.

  • Previous experience as a General Counsel or senior legal leader, with experience leading both senior and junior legal professionals.

  • Experience operating within a scaling, venture-backed or PE-backed global technology business.

  • Strong experience across commercial contracting, corporate law, privacy, data protection and cybersecurity.

  • Experience advising a Board and senior executives on complex legal, governance and risk matters.

  • Experience supporting M&A and corporate transactions.

  • The ability to operate effectively across multiple jurisdictions, particularly the United States, APAC and Europe.

  • Exposure to frameworks such as ISO 27001, ISO 27701 and SOC 2 is highly regarded.

  • Fluency in another language, particularly French, is advantageous but not required.

The kind of leader who will thrive here

You're commercially minded and know that great in-house legal advice isn't simply about identifying risk – it's about helping the business understand that risk and make good decisions.

You'll be comfortable moving between a Board-level conversation and the practical detail of a commercial negotiation. You can simplify complex legal issues for non-legal audiences, anticipate issues before they become problems and make sound decisions in an environment that is growing quickly.

You'll also bring the credibility and leadership capability to influence senior stakeholders globally, alongside the autonomy and adaptability required in a fast-paced scale-up environment.

Why Eftsure?

This is an opportunity to take on a genuinely global General Counsel mandate at an important point in Eftsure's growth.

You'll have direct access to the CEO and Board, lead legal and risk strategy across multiple international markets, and have the opportunity to build the frameworks, capability and infrastructure that will support Eftsure as we continue to scale.

If you're an experienced legal leader who enjoys combining legal rigour, commercial judgement and strategic influence, we'd love to hear from you.

jobs.description:
We're looking for an experienced Staff Frontend QA Automation Engineer to join our fast-growing tech team in HCMC, focusing on web applications and browser-based user journeys. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable frontend automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance web experience.

Overview:

Our mission is to become the global standard for addressing. Street addresses weren’t designed for 2026. They aren’t accurate enough to specify building entrances, and they don’t exist for parks, rural areas and many parts of the world. This makes it hard to find places and causes problems and inefficiencies on a global scale.

That’s why we created what3words. We divided the world into 3m squares and gave each square a unique combination of three words. It’s the easiest way to find and share precise locations.

Over the last year, what3words has been used in 193 countries, and our monthly active users continue to grow at an impressive pace. Our tech is used by emergency services, delivery companies, eCommerce businesses, ride-hailing apps and NGOs, and is integrated into the navigation systems of millions of cars around the world.

The role:

You’ll be joining our fast-growing tech team, focusing on our web applications, frontend user journeys, and browser-based experiences. You’ll be responsible for designing and implementing robust, scalable automation using Playwright to ensure our users have a seamless, high-performance experience.

Your rigorous attention to detail and excellent communication skills will be essential. If you are passionate about quality and have a proven competence in automating test cases for frontend and web applications, we’d like to hear from you.

Responsibilities:

  • Build and maintain frontend end-to-end test suites in Playwright and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines for our core web applications.

  • Ensure consistent functionality and UI/UX integrity across modern browsers, responsive layouts, and screen resolutions.

  • Conduct a mix of manual exploration and automated regression to find and report frontend-specific bugs, from flaky UI states and accessibility issues to broken journeys.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers and Product Managers to develop effective strategies and test plans for our web applications.

  • Help troubleshoot issues in production and staging environments.

  • Conduct post-release/post-implementation testing including regression, accessibility, and integration testing for frontend systems.

Essential Skills:

  • Frontend Automation: Experience building robust web automation frameworks using Playwright, with a focus on reliable end-to-end and cross-browser functional testing.

  • Frontend CI/CD Integration: Experience integrating Playwright test suites into build pipelines, including parallel execution, test reporting, trace/video capture, and flaky test management.

  • JavaScript/TypeScript Proficiency: Strong JavaScript or TypeScript programming skills, with confidence building maintainable test frameworks and utilities.

  • DevOps Ecosystem: Experience with build and configuration tools such as GitHub Actions and CircleCI.

  • Browser & UI Savvy: A keen eye for frontend-specific nuances, including responsive behaviour, accessibility, browser compatibility, loading states, and visual consistency.

  • Soft Skills: Excellent communication in spoken and written English, paired with a product mindset and rigorous attention to detail.

Extra credit if you:

  • Have worked with modern frontend frameworks such as React, Next.js, Vue, or Angular.

  • Experience working with backend services.

  • Experience with BDD and implementing Cucumber for automation.

  • Have experience with accessibility testing, visual regression testing, or performance testing for web applications.

jobs.description:
About Plooto

Plooto is a payment automation platform built to help accountants, bookkeepers, and their clients take control of their payables and receivables. From approval workflows and audit trails to bulk payments and automated reconciliation, Plooto gives customers time back and confidence that their books are accurate and up to date.

Our customers range from busy entrepreneurs to finance teams and non-profits, with a strong footprint among accounting firms and bookkeeping professionals across Canada.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Manager, Privacy & Regulatory Compliance to lead and scale Plooto’s privacy program while helping the business adopt AI, automation, and data-driven technologies responsibly.

Privacy expertise is the foundation of this role. As AI becomes more widely adopted across Plooto, the number and complexity of decisions involving personal and sensitive information will continue to grow. You will help the business navigate these decisions thoughtfully—establishing clear guardrails, identifying material risks, and enabling teams to innovate without creating unnecessary process or paperwork.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who is pragmatic, curious, and comfortable working in areas where the answers are still evolving. We are not looking for someone with decades of AI governance experience. We are looking for a strong privacy professional who is genuinely interested in AI, asks thoughtful questions, keeps up with emerging developments, and is excited to help shape Plooto’s approach.

You will also support the ongoing implementation of Plooto’s Enterprise Risk Management framework and provide additional capacity across the broader regulatory compliance program. Prior depth in ERM or AML/ATF is not essential; what matters is an ability and willingness to learn, apply sound judgment, and contribute where needed.

You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, People, Operations, and other teams to translate complex requirements into practical, proportionate solutions that help Plooto move quickly and responsibly.

The role reports to the Senior Manager, Compliance within the Payments Strategy & Compliance function.

Key Responsibilities

Privacy is the primary focus of this role. The role will also provide flexible support for enterprise risk management and broader regulatory compliance priorities as business needs evolve

  • Lead and continuously improve Plooto’s privacy program, serving as a primary privacy subject-matter expert and supporting compliance with PIPEDA, Quebec Law 25, Alberta PIPA, BC PIPA, and other applicable privacy requirements.
  • Provide practical privacy guidance to the business, translating legal and regulatory requirements into clear, risk-based actions without creating unnecessary documentation, approvals, or operational friction.
  • Lead privacy assessments for new products, features, vendors, and data uses, including Privacy Impact Assessments. Apply a proportionate approach so the depth of review and documentation reflects the actual level of risk.
  • Help shape Plooto’s approach to responsible AI, developing lightweight, scalable methods for assessing AI tools and use cases across privacy, data use, transparency, retention, access, automated decision-making, and third-party processing.
  • Embed privacy by design into how Plooto operates, partnering with Product, Engineering, Security, People, and other teams early in the development and implementation of new products, AI tools, models, vendors, and automated processes.
  • Manage core privacy operations, including data rights requests, privacy incidents and breach assessments, third-party privacy reviews, cross-border data considerations, and data retention and deletion practices.
  • Monitor emerging privacy, data, and AI developments in Canada and the United States, determine which developments are relevant to Plooto, and convert them into focused, actionable recommendations.
  • Support the rollout and ongoing implementation of Plooto’s Enterprise Risk Management framework, including coordinating risk assessments, maintaining the enterprise risk register, monitoring mitigation activities, and supporting risk reporting.
  • Help make risk management a practical business discipline, working with leaders to identify material risks, clarify ownership, track meaningful actions, and maintain reporting that supports decision-making rather than documentation for its own sake.
  • Support regulatory change and third-party risk activities, helping assess new requirements and higher-risk relationships, identify accountable owners, and track implementation of proportionate controls.
  • Provide flexible support across Plooto’s broader regulatory compliance program, including regulatory initiatives, audits, effectiveness reviews, remediation work, obligations under the Retail Payment Activities Act, and AML/ATF requirements under the PCMLTFA and FINTRAC guidance.
  • Build understanding and accountability across the organization through clear guidance, practical tools, and training on privacy, responsible AI, and risk management.

Qualifications

  • 3–6+ years of hands-on privacy experience, ideally within fintech, payments, technology, banking, financial services, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Canadian privacy requirements, particularly PIPEDA and Quebec Law 25, with familiarity with Alberta and British Columbia privacy legislation.
  • Practical experience conducting Privacy Impact Assessments, privacy reviews, data rights requests, and privacy incident or breach assessments.
  • The judgment to apply privacy requirements proportionately and develop controls that are defensible, practical, and appropriate to the underlying risk.
  • Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technologies, including an interest in learning how new tools use data and helping the organization navigate evolving privacy and governance considerations.
  • You do not need extensive AI governance experience. Experience reviewing AI tools, automated processing, emerging technologies, or data-governance matters is an asset.
  • An ability to simplify complex requirements and create clear guidance, decision frameworks, and processes that people will actually use.
  • A practical, action-oriented mindset. You are comfortable building structure where it is needed while avoiding bureaucracy that does not meaningfully reduce risk.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to work collaboratively across Product, Engineering, Security, People, Operations, Legal, and leadership teams.
  • The ability to independently manage competing priorities, exercise sound judgment, and recognize when an issue requires escalation.
  • Familiarity with U.S. privacy frameworks, including CCPA/CPRA and emerging state privacy laws, is an asset.
  • Exposure to enterprise risk management, third-party risk, fintech regulation, payments compliance, or AML/ATF is helpful but not required. You should be curious and willing to build knowledge in these areas with the support of the broader Compliance team.
  • CIPP/C certification is preferred. CIPP/US, CIPM, or other relevant privacy certifications are assets.
  • Bilingualism in English and French is an asset given Plooto’s Canadian regulatory obligations.

Why Become a Plootonian?

If you’re looking to make a meaningful impact, look no further. We’re transforming the payments space in North America by delivering an unrivalled product experience that solves a real and pressing problem for SMBs.

One of the biggest challenges small businesses face is managing their finances and cash flow—and Plooto helps address that. We have strong product-market fit, a significant opportunity ahead, and the backing of experienced fintech leaders.

You’ll join a team that cares deeply about customer impact, takes pride in its craft, and moves with urgency. We’re just getting started, and you’ll help shape the next chapter of our growth story.

Join Plooto and be part of a mission that matters.

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Plooto is committed to building an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can thrive. We know great teams are built through diverse thinking, and we encourage you to apply even if your experience does not align perfectly with every qualification listed.

Accommodation is available throughout the recruitment process in accordance with applicable accessibility legislation. If you require accommodation at any stage, please let us know—we’re happy to work with you.

This posting is for one available position. Compensation will be determined based on the successful candidate’s knowledge, skills, experience, and overall alignment with the role.

About bunny.net

Some people accept the internet as it is. We see what it could be.

At bunny.net, we don’t wait for change. We make it happen. You won’t find layers of red tape or play-it-safe thinking here. You’ll find people who move quickly, take ownership, and push ideas all the way to the edge. Literally.

You’ll build things that solve actual problems, not add to them.

We’re not perfect, and we don’t pretend to be. But we’re always improving. We’re looking for people who want to do the same, who take pride in their work, and aren’t afraid to challenge what’s possible.

Because everyone deserves a better internet. And we’re here to help it hop faster.

Lead Product Engineer (Developer Platform)

What if you could design the way developers ship their workloads to the edge, starting from a blank page?

As a Lead Product Engineer at bunny.net, you'll own the Developer Platform and lead a small team of engineers. We already give developers the pieces to run compute close to their users: Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database. What's missing is the glue: the part that turns a set of products into one obvious way to say "deploy my workload to bunny." That glue is yours: projects, environments like dev, staging, and production, secrets shared at the right level, logs you can actually read, and a container that talks to a database without a detour through the docs.

Product Engineering sits inside Engineering. There's no Product Manager handing over requirements: you carry the product responsibilities yourself, and you shape solutions with your engineers in the codebase, not just in the conversation. How much you build yourself depends on you and on what the team needs, but shipping code is part of the role, not a bonus.

It’s a role for someone who loves both the why and the how, combining strong product judgment with technical depth, and knowing when to get hands-on and when to help others find the way forward.

You’ll have the context to see the bigger picture, the freedom to challenge assumptions, and teams that challenge your thinking right back.

If you love being close to developers, turning a blank page into something people ship on every day, and helping a team get the details right, you'll feel right at home here.

What will you do?

  • Design the primitives developers use, such as projects, environments, secrets, and logs, and how they behave across Magic Containers, Edge Scripting, and Database, so deploying, configuring, connecting, and debugging a workload on bunny.net feels like one product

  • Shape Developer Platform product direction from discovery through delivery and iteration, turning developer insights into clear priorities

  • Spot and resolve platform or product decisions that break the unified developer experience before they ship

  • Bring clarity to hard problems and give teams the context to make great decisions on their own, raising the bar for product thinking, technical judgment, and ownership beyond your own team

  • Lead a small engineering team: set direction, develop people, give clear feedback, and hold a high bar for what you ship and run

  • Build alongside your engineers across prototypes, APIs, dashboard, instrumentation, docs, and production code

  • Define and measure success, from first deploy to adoption and expansion, and use what you learn to decide what comes next

  • Work across Compute, Frontend, Design, and Product Marketing to create a cohesive experience across the dashboard, API, CLI, and docs

What will you bring?

  • Ideally, you’ve owned the full discovery → delivery → iteration loop at meaningful scale, or you’re ready to take on that level of end-to-end ownership

  • Strong product judgment and a knack for turning messy, ambiguous problems into meaningful outcomes

  • Comfort with data: knowing what to measure, what funnels and retention curves are telling you, and when to run an experiment

  • Business and market literacy: ICP, pricing, competition, revenue drivers, and how your product supports bunny.net's wider strategy

  • Strong technical depth to challenge solutions, make trade-offs, and ship production changes yourself

  • A high bar for quality, reliability, performance, security, and customer trust

  • A track record of helping others make better decisions and take more ownership

  • Clear communication, high ownership, and low ego

  • AI fluency: using AI thoughtfully across research, analysis, prototyping, coding, testing, and communication, while staying accountable for quality

What will make us extra happy?

  • Experience building developer platforms, deployment tools, or products where the developer experience is the product

  • You've deployed, configured, and debugged your own workloads on similar platforms

  • You’re as comfortable talking to customers as you are digging into the technology

  • You naturally think beyond individual features and see how products, systems, and teams fit together

  • Experience leading engineers: developing people, giving feedback, and creating the conditions for a team to make product decisions rather than execute tasks

Where should you be located?

Europe, ideally within CET ±3 hours so collaboration with the team feels natural rather than scheduled.

What's in it for you?

Life at bunny.net comes with benefits that make work (and life) better.

  • 100% flexible hours - Your work, your rhythm. Whether you thrive at 3 am or on a beach at noon, we've got you.

  • Remote-first by design - No offices, no commute, just the freedom to work anywhere. Miss the office? We’ll give you a 3-night voucher for visiting our headquarters.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance - Coverage worldwide.

  • Paid time off - Love the slopes or the sea? Enjoy them with 25 vacation days, plus an extra loyalty day each year, capped at 5 years (30 days total), on top of your local public holidays.

  • Meeting-free Thursdays - We keep Thursdays meeting free internally so you can focus on deep work without interruptions.

  • Home office budget - We believe everyone is more efficient working in a comfortable office, and we're happy to help you set it up with an annual budget of €500.

  • Paid sick leave - Feeling ill? Take time off to fully recover without having to worry about your finances.

  • Parental leave - Paid 16 weeks for birthing parents, 8 weeks for non-birthing parents. If your country gives more, that’s your baseline. If it gives less, we top it up. Take your leave all at once or split it across the first year for maximum flexibility. After paid leave, your local statutory rules apply.

  • Annual fluffle building - We're remote, but not distant! Once a year, we meet in a sunny location where virtual high-fives turn into real ones.

  • Employee Stock Option Plan (ESOP) - Everyone at bunny.net gets a piece of the pie, starting with 0.01% equity.

  • Mental health support - Feeling down? We've got your back. bunny.net provides mental health resources and help via .

  • Wellness budget - An annual well-being budget of €480 is here to help you stay fresh and focused.

  • Educational budget - €500 yearly for books, seminars, or online courses to keep your learning on track, work-related or not.

  • Music on us: Work is better with music. Enjoy a yearly Apple, Spotify, or YouTube Premium subscription on us.

Description

TripleTen is a career learning platform for people in a world being reshaped by AI. We help people learn the tech and AI skills to move into higher-paying roles and keep up as the economy shifts. Established in 2019, we are part of Nebius Group, a global leader in AI infrastructure. We work remotely across the US, Europe, LatAm, and beyond.

About the role

﻿

Our brand and marketing team ships a lot with few people across several zones, and the small work has outgrown us: pages to update, articles to republish, tickets going stale, finished work nobody can find. This role picks that up and puts a system under it. The biggest recurring piece is the blog. Search engines were happy to leave a good article alone for a year; AI assistants are not, so everything we publish gets refreshed regularly.

You’ll report to our Brand Director and work closely with a strong team of brand, organic and social media marketers, designers, and copywriter.

What you will do

  • Blog refresh: Work closely with our SEO/GEO Growth Engineer to update roughly 10-20 published articles a month with Claude. Update facts, tighten structure, put finished text live and check if its formatting, links, images, and copy landed well.
  • Small page edits: Minor changes on live pages—a date, a price, a link. Our Claude agents know where the components live, but they need you to tell what to change.
  • Coordination: Chase the pieces an article needs before it ships: a student quote, a cover brief, a fresh instructor photo; ping a vendor for a lost invoice, get it and upload into our internal billing system.
  • The records: Keep the change log and team’s Jira board current.
  • The system: help us identify repeatable tasks and their cadence to initiate automations and then keep them running.

Requirements

  • Hands-on work with Claude or similar: You've used one on real work, and you know where it gets things wrong.
  • Junior project-management skill: You carry a batch of small tasks at once and close them without being chased. You'd rather build a system than keep remembering.
  • A careful eye: You catch a wrong number, a dead link, a changed heading.
  • B2+ English: Strong enough to spot AI patterns in published copy and hear when a sentence stops sounding natural.
  • Comfortable in a repo and a tracker: we use GitHub + Claude Code, WordPress, Jira, Figma, Notion. If you’re not familiar with them, be prepared to pick up quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Basic marketing understanding: enough context to see why a page, an article, or a funnel exists, how they get found, and question links with no UTMs.
  • Experience keeping a team's tickets, files, or documentation in order.

What we can offer you

  • Remote, part-time collaboration (about 20 hours per week).
  • Room to grow into more hours, full-time and a wider role in brand, marketing, or production.
  • Full onboarding into our AI-first stack and our brand kit.
  • A close-knit global team across the US, Europe, and LatAm.

This job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required. Nothing in this job description restricts management's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities at any time.

TripleTen is an equal employment opportunity/affirmative action employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, religion, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, protected military/veteran status, or any other legally protected factor.

What we are looking for

This role exists to optimise how people and partners are deployed across global portfolios, ensuring the right talent is on the right projects at the right time. You’ll oversee day-to-day resourcing, balancing full-time and contractor teams to meet delivery needs and operational goals. Acting as a bridge between Delivery, Creative, Strategy, and Operations, you’ll resolve capacity conflicts, facilitate portfolio resourcing discussions, and ensure global capacity is leveraged effectively. This is a strategic and hands-on role requiring strong commercial acumen, stakeholder management, and operational rigour.

What you will do:

Resource Planning & Allocation

  • Oversee daily resourcing across multiple client portfolios, in close partnership with Delivery and Creative/Strategy leads.
  • Lead global portfolio resourcing calls, facilitating capacity discussions and resolving conflicts quickly and pragmatically.

Contractor Management

  • Coach and mentor colleagues to develop consistent and proactive resourcing practices.

  • Operationally sharp, translating complex policies and processes into simple, efficient workflows.
  • An excellent communicator and collaborator, able to build alignment across Delivery, Client Services, Creative, Strategy, and Operations teams.
  • Highly organized and proactive, with strong follow-through on commitments and the ability to anticipate challenges.
  • Personable problem-solver who brings clarity and calm to tense situations, keeping operations running smoothly.

What you will need:

  • Deep understanding of project delivery cycles in creative or B2B marketing contexts.
  • Advanced skills in resource planning and operational tools such as Kantata/Mavenlink, Float, 10kft, Smartsheet, and Excel.
  • Strong commercial mindset, able to balance financial efficiency with operational and resourcing excellence.
  • Proven ability to communicate effectively and manage stakeholders across senior levels.
  • Confident operating in a complex, matrixed, global environment.

Benefits

What we offer in return

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance: Health is a priority worth investing in. We empower every employee to take charge of their health by providing comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance so they can perform at their best ability.
  • Pre-tax flexible spending account (FSA) – healthcare, dependent care, and transit available: We are committed to saving you money as we provide high-quality healthcare that is as flexible and diverse as our team.
  • 4% 401(k) contribution with no vesting period: We are invested in our employees' careers. Each individual has the opportunity to build a future for themselves through a 401(k), and we see that as a success for the company as well.
  • Plentiful paid time off: Each employee has the freedom to choose how long they want to be away from work. We recommend at least 20 days of PTO, so employees can fully rest and avoid burnout.
  • Sick leave (15 days annually): Illnesses are taken seriously at tmp. We provide 15 days of sick leave so employees can take their time to make a full recovery before returning to work.
  • Holiday shutdown (December 26th - 29th): As the whole company shuts down for a few days, you can celebrate the holidays with loved ones.
  • Parental leave:
    • Primary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay and then 12 weeks 50% pay
    • Secondary caregiver: 12 weeks full pay
  • Access to Unmind: Our well-being platform, including access to therapists and coaches
  • Employer-funded life, AD&D & disability insurance: tmp offers all employees life and AD&D insurance and makes sure you and your loved ones are protected in times of need.
  • Company getaways: Whether it is a local office holiday party or a full-blown international trip, we believe in bonding through quality time spent together as a team.

We are currently eligible to hire within these US states:

CA, CO, IL, WA, and TX.

A note on applying:

Not sure you tick every box? Apply anyway. Research shows some people hold back unless they meet 100% of the requirements. We do not want that to be you.

At tmp, we hire for potential, mindset, and character as much as experience. If you are excited about the role but your background is not a perfect match, we would still love to hear from you. You might be exactly what we are looking for, either for this role or another.

Diversity equals increased creativity, which equals better results for all. We’re committed to equality of opportunity and applications from all individuals are encouraged. If you have a disability or additional need that requires accommodation, please don’t hesitate to let us know.

Employment Type: Independent Contractor | Full-Time & Part-Time
Work Arrangement: Fully Remote | Work schedule will depend on client requirements and agreed availability.

Hours: 15–40 hours per week
Time Zones: U.S. Eastern, Central, or Pacific Time

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Bilingual Senior Medical Billing & Coding Specialist who is fluent in English and Spanish and has strong hands-on experience supporting U.S. healthcare practices.

The ideal candidate will have at least 3 years of direct experience working within a U.S. healthcare practice or medical organization, with hands-on responsibility for medical billing, coding, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM), Accounts Receivable (AR), claims, and denial management.

We are particularly interested in professionals who have worked directly within a healthcare specialty such as Primary Care, Behavioral Health, Mental Health, Dental, Ophthalmology, or another U.S. medical practice setting.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the full billing and revenue cycle process—not simply someone with general administrative or healthcare experience.

Key Responsibilities

  • Handle day-to-day U.S. medical billing and coding activities.
  • Prepare, review, and submit accurate claims to Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.
  • Review patient accounts, medical records, and billing information for accuracy.
  • Apply and interpret CPT, ICD-10, HCPCS, and relevant modifier codes as applicable to the practice.
  • Identify and correct coding or billing errors that may result in claim rejections or denials.
  • Manage denials, rejected claims, appeals, and claim corrections.
  • Perform Accounts Receivable (AR) follow-up and monitor outstanding balances.
  • Investigate unpaid and underpaid claims and follow up with insurance companies.
  • Support the overall Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) process from charge entry through payment and account resolution.
  • Verify and maintain accurate patient and insurance information.
  • Review Explanation of Benefits (EOBs) and Electronic Remittance Advice (ERAs).
  • Identify trends in denials, payment issues, and billing discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.
  • Communicate professionally with insurance companies, healthcare providers, patients, and internal teams as needed.
  • Maintain accurate documentation and follow client-specific billing and compliance procedures.
  • Work independently in a remote environment while meeting productivity, accuracy, and turnaround-time expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience in U.S. healthcare medical billing and coding.
  • Direct experience working within a U.S. healthcare practice, clinic, dental practice, behavioral health organization, ophthalmology practice, or similar healthcare setting.
  • Strong understanding of the U.S. healthcare revenue cycle.
  • Hands-on experience with: Medical Billing, Medical Coding, Claims Submission, Denial Management, Accounts Receivable (AR), Payment Posting, Claim Follow-up, Revenue Cycle Management (RCM)
  • Experience working with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance payers.
  • Strong working knowledge of CPT codes and familiarity with ICD-10 and HCPCS coding.
  • Ability to identify coding and billing discrepancies and resolve claim-related issues.
  • Fluent in both English and Spanish, with the ability to communicate professionally in both languages.
  • Strong computer skills and ability to learn and navigate healthcare billing systems, EHRs, EMRs, and payer portals.
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to work independently and manage priorities in a remote environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with healthcare billing software, EHR/EMR systems, clearinghouses, and payer portals.
  • Experience handling complex denials, appeals, and aging AR.
  • Medical billing or coding certification such as CPC, CCS, CPB, CCA, or equivalent.

Certification is not required, but relevant medical billing or coding certification is considered a strong plus.

What We’re Looking For

We are looking for a senior-level, hands-on billing and coding professional who understands how billing works within an actual U.S. healthcare practice.

Strong candidates should be able to demonstrate practical experience—not just familiarity—with coding, claims, payer processes, denials, AR, and the broader RCM cycle.

Experience in a specific clinical practice environment is highly valued, particularly where the candidate understands the billing workflow and payer requirements associated with that specialty.

Important Note for Applicants

When applying, please ensure your CV clearly highlights:

  1. Your 3+ years of U.S. medical billing and coding experience.
  2. The specific healthcare practices or specialties you have worked with.
  3. Your experience with Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial insurance.
  4. Your hands-on experience with CPT/ICD-10/HCPCS coding.
  5. Your experience with RCM, denials, AR, claims, and payment posting.
  6. The healthcare billing systems, EHRs/EMRs, clearinghouses, or payer portals you have used.
  7. Your English and Spanish proficiency.
  8. Any medical billing or coding certifications you hold.

Candidates whose experience is primarily general healthcare administration without hands-on U.S. medical billing/coding experience may not be considered.

We are currently seeking individuals who are interested in full-time opportunities.

About Elm AI

At Elm AI, we’re rebuilding supplier operations for an agent-first world.

We believe the next generation of enterprise software will not be passive systems of record. It will be made up of agents that stay live inside important workflows: understanding context, coordinating action, and keeping critical work moving across teams, suppliers, documents, systems, and decisions.

That is what Elm AI is building.

Our agents operate across responsible sourcing and supplier operations, helping companies manage audit review, corrective actions, supplier follow-through, remediation, scorecards, supplier portals, document review, and broader operational workflows that still run on spreadsheets, email, and manual coordination.

Elm is already live with major consumer brands, supporting supplier programs that span thousands of factories and some of the most operationally complex supply chains in the world.

Our ambition is much larger: to build the agent-first operating layer for how global supplier work gets done.

The Role

We’re hiring a Strategic Customer Success Manager to own high-value customer relationships and help customers deploy AI into real supply chain workflows.

This is not a traditional “check-in and renewal” customer success role.

You’ll work closely with sourcing, supply chain, responsible sourcing, compliance, and operations teams to understand how work actually gets done today: the SOPs, spreadsheets, handoffs, follow-ups, exceptions, dashboards, supplier communications, and recurring manual processes that keep supplier operations moving.

Then you’ll help turn those workflows into AI-powered systems that create measurable business value.

You’ll be part customer partner, part operator, part product thinker, and part solutions strategist. You should be comfortable sitting with a customer, unpacking a messy process, identifying where AI can create ROI, and working closely with our product and engineering team to bring that solution to life.

The ideal person is excited by startups, AI, enterprise software, and the practical reality of deploying technology into complex operational environments.

What You’ll Do

  • Own strategic customer relationships from onboarding through adoption, expansion, and renewal
  • Lead customers through deployment of Elm’s AI workflows across responsible sourcing and broader supplier operations
  • Map customer workflows, SOPs, pain points, data sources, and manual processes
  • Identify high-ROI opportunities where AI can reduce manual work, improve speed, increase visibility, or help teams do more with less
  • Translate customer needs into clear product, workflow, and implementation requirements
  • Partner closely with engineering and product to shape deployments and improve the platform
  • Drive adoption across customer teams, including operators, program managers, executives, and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Build repeatable playbooks for onboarding, workflow discovery, rollout, value tracking, and expansion
  • Turn customer data, usage patterns, and operational context into clear recommendations
  • Help customers understand what AI can realistically do inside their supply chain operations
  • Surface expansion opportunities by understanding the broader operational problems customers are trying to solve
  • Help shape Elm’s customer success motion as we scale

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is energized by customers, technology, and ambiguity.

You may have a background in customer success, consulting, implementation, solutions, product, operations, or a similarly customer-facing role. What matters most is that you can understand complex workflows, earn trust with customers, and help turn messy operational problems into clear, high-value solutions.

You might be a strong fit if you have:

  • 3–7 years of experience in customer success, consulting, implementation, solutions, product, operations, or a related role
  • Experience working with technical or enterprise software products
  • Strong interest in AI and how it changes business operations
  • Comfort working with customers to map workflows, diagnose problems, and define success metrics
  • Ability to speak with both operators and executives
  • Strong program management instincts and excellent follow-through
  • Data fluency: you can interpret dashboards, spot patterns, and translate findings into recommendations
  • A high degree of ownership and comfort operating without perfect structure

- Clear written and verbal communication

  • Curiosity about supply chains, sourcing, manufacturing, compliance, logistics, procurement, or supplier operations

Bonus Points

Not required, but helpful:

  • Experience in supply chain, sourcing, procurement, logistics, manufacturing, ESG, responsible sourcing, or compliance

- Experience at an early-stage startup

  • Experience in solutions engineering, implementation, or forward-deployed customer work
  • Comfort with technical concepts such as APIs, data models, workflows, integrations, or AI agents
  • Experience working with global teams across the U.S., Europe, and Asia
  • Experience selling, deploying, or supporting AI-native products

The Kind of Person Who Tends to Thrive at Elm AI

The people who thrive here are usually curious, high-agency, and a little averse to inefficient processes.

They like getting close to the customer. They ask good questions. They want to understand the actual work behind the process: who does it, why it exists, where it breaks, what it costs, and what would happen if it worked 10x better.

They are excited by AI, but they are not hand-wavy about it. They care about practical outcomes: hours saved, processes accelerated, exceptions resolved, decisions improved, and teams able to do more with less.

They don’t need a perfect playbook before moving. They help create the playbook.

They are comfortable in the messy middle between customer conversations, product strategy, implementation details, and business value. They can zoom out to an executive narrative and zoom in to a spreadsheet, SOP, or workflow diagram.

They care deeply about customers, but they also care about building a company that can scale.

Why This Role

- High ownership from day one

  • Direct exposure to founders, customers, product, and strategy
  • The chance to help define a new category of AI-native supply chain software
  • Work with major global brands on real operational problems
  • A role that can grow into customer success, solutions, implementation, or go-to-market leadership
  • Several years of runway, backed by top investors
  • A team that is ambitious, technical, thoughtful, and moving quickly

Working Style & Time Overlap

This role is remote, but requires meaningful overlap with U.S. Eastern Time.

You should be comfortable working primarily in EST hours, with flexibility to accommodate customers across Europe and Asia when needed.

Perks & Support

- Competitive compensation

  • High-trust, high-ownership work environment

- Learning and development budget

- Generous AI and tooling budget

  • Personal spend card for experimentation, software, education, or anything that helps you learn and work better
  • A culture that supports sustainable work, both in how we operate and how we build the business

jobs.excerpt: Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)About the RoleWe are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
jobs.description:
Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO)

About the Role

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.

The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.

As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.

The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership

Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.

Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.

Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.

Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.

Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

2. Group P&L & Financial Performance

Assume overall responsibility for the Group's financial performance, profitability, balance sheet, cash flow, and capital position.

Monitor performance across all subsidiaries and business lines.

Drive sustainable earnings growth, expense efficiency, and return on capital.

Establish Group-wide financial KPIs and performance dashboards.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

3. Financial Planning & Performance Management

Lead Group-wide annual budgeting, forecasting, and long-range financial planning.

Develop financial scenarios and stress tests to support strategic decision-making.

Consolidate financial plans across subsidiaries and investment businesses.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.

Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

4. Insurance Finance

Provide executive oversight of financial management across insurance businesses.

Monitor premiums, claims, reserves, expenses, underwriting results, and insurance profitability.

Oversee financial analysis of loss ratios, combined ratios, expense ratios, and underwriting margins.

Partner with actuarial, underwriting, claims, and risk functions to understand financial exposures.

Provide financial input into product profitability, pricing, reinsurance, and portfolio decisions.

5. Investment & Asset Management Finance

Provide Group-level financial oversight of investment portfolios and investment businesses.

Partner with the Chief Investment Officer (CIO) and Investment Committee on investment strategy and performance.

Monitor investment income, portfolio returns, asset allocation, liquidity, and risk-adjusted performance.

Evaluate strategic investment opportunities and major portfolio decisions.

Ensure investment activities support the Group's liabilities, capital objectives, liquidity needs, and risk appetite.

6. Group Capital & Solvency Management

Lead Group-wide capital planning and capital optimization.

Monitor capital adequacy, solvency, leverage, liquidity, and financial resilience.

Develop strategies to optimize capital deployment across subsidiaries and business lines.

Assess the capital implications of acquisitions, investments, dividends, growth initiatives, and strategic transactions.

Partner with Risk and Actuarial leadership on capital and solvency assessments.

7. Asset-Liability Management

Provide executive oversight of asset-liability management (ALM) across relevant insurance and investment businesses.

Ensure investment portfolios are appropriately aligned with insurance liabilities and liquidity requirements.

Monitor duration, interest-rate sensitivity, liquidity gaps, and market exposures.

Support balance-sheet optimization and financial stress-testing initiatives.

8. Treasury & Liquidity

Lead Group treasury, liquidity, cash management, and banking relationships.

Establish Group-wide liquidity policies and funding strategies.

Optimize cash across subsidiaries while maintaining appropriate regulatory and operational liquidity.

Oversee debt facilities, guarantees, intercompany funding, and treasury risk.

Monitor interest-rate, foreign-exchange, credit, and liquidity exposures.

9. Capital Raising & Financing

Lead Group-level financing and capital-raising initiatives.

Develop relationships with banks, institutional investors, private equity firms, development-finance institutions, debt providers, and capital-market participants.

Oversee debt issuance, refinancing, capital injections, and other funding strategies.

Optimize the Group's capital structure and cost of capital.

Ensure funding capacity supports strategic growth.

10. M&A, Investments & Corporate Development

Lead financial evaluation of acquisitions, disposals, strategic investments, and joint ventures.

Oversee financial due diligence, valuation, transaction modeling, and deal structuring.

Assess the impact of transactions on earnings, capital, solvency, liquidity, and shareholder value.

Partner with the CEO and Board on major strategic transactions.

Oversee financial integration and post-transaction performance.

11. Group Financial Reporting & Consolidation

Ensure accurate and timely consolidated financial reporting across the Group.

Oversee statutory accounts, management reporting, regulatory returns, and Board reporting.

Establish consistent accounting and reporting standards across subsidiaries.

Ensure compliance with applicable accounting standards and insurance regulations.

Maintain strong relationships with external auditors and professional advisers.

12. Regulatory & Governance

Maintain strong financial governance across the Group.

Ensure compliance with applicable insurance, investment, corporate, tax, and financial regulations.

Manage relationships with regulators, auditors, rating agencies, and other external stakeholders.

Establish effective internal controls and financial policies.

Ensure appropriate governance across subsidiaries, SPVs, joint ventures, and investment entities.

13. Financial Risk Management

Establish and oversee the Group's financial risk-management framework.

Monitor market, credit, liquidity, underwriting, investment, interest-rate, FX, and operational financial risks.

Establish appropriate stress-testing and contingency-planning processes.

Work closely with the Group CRO, Chief Actuary, CIO, and business leaders to manage enterprise-wide risk.

14. Tax Strategy

Oversee Group-wide tax planning, compliance, reporting, and risk management.

Ensure appropriate tax governance across subsidiaries and jurisdictions.

Identify opportunities for legitimate tax efficiency.

Monitor changes in tax and regulatory requirements affecting the Group.

15. Investor & Stakeholder Relations

Develop strong relationships with shareholders, institutional investors, lenders, rating agencies, regulators, and other financial stakeholders.

Lead financial communications to the Board and key investors.

Support investor presentations, annual reports, strategic reviews, and capital-market activities.

Clearly communicate the Group's financial strategy, performance, and outlook.

16. Finance Transformation

Modernize the Group's finance operating model, systems, processes, and reporting infrastructure.

Strengthen ERP, FP&A, consolidation, business intelligence, and financial analytics capabilities.

Drive automation and digital transformation across finance.

Improve transparency and real-time visibility across subsidiaries and business units.

17. Leadership & Organizational Development

Lead the Group Finance function and senior finance leadership across subsidiaries.

Develop a high-performing, commercially focused finance organization.

Establish common standards, talent-development programs, and succession plans.

Build strong relationships with subsidiary CFOs and Finance Directors.

Promote a culture of integrity, accountability, financial discipline, and value creation.

Key Performance Indicators

The Group CFO will be accountable for:

Group revenue and earnings growth

Group EBITDA / net income performance

Return on equity (ROE)

Return on capital

Capital adequacy and solvency

Investment portfolio performance

Investment income and risk-adjusted returns

Insurance underwriting profitability

Combined ratio / loss ratio performance

Expense efficiency

Liquidity and cash-flow strength

Balance-sheet optimization

Cost of capital

Capital-raising effectiveness

M&A and strategic-investment performance

Budget and forecast accuracy

Regulatory and reporting compliance

Financial risk management

Shareholder value creation

Candidate Profile

Essential Experience

18+ years of progressive finance experience, including substantial Group or enterprise-level leadership.

Previous experience as Group CFO, CFO, Deputy Group CFO, Group Finance Director, Finance Director, or equivalent.

Significant experience within insurance, investment management, asset management, banking, pensions, reinsurance, or diversified financial services.

Proven experience managing complex group structures, subsidiaries, investment entities, and regulated businesses.

Strong understanding of insurance financial reporting, capital and solvency requirements, investment portfolios, and balance-sheet management.

Demonstrated experience in capital allocation, treasury, liquidity, financial planning, and enterprise risk.

Experience working directly with Boards, CEOs, regulators, auditors, investors, lenders, and rating agencies.

Preferred Experience

Previous Group CFO experience within a diversified insurance or investment group.

Experience covering both insurance operations and investment/asset-management businesses.

Exposure to life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, pensions, or institutional investment.

Experience managing significant investment portfolios and ALM.

Proven experience with M&A, capital raising, restructuring, strategic investments, or international expansion.

Experience across multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

Experience working with international institutional investors or rating agencies.

Education & Professional Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

Professional qualification such as CA, ACCA, CPA, CMA, CFA, or equivalent strongly preferred.

MBA or Master's degree in Finance/Business is advantageous.

Additional insurance, investment, actuarial, or risk-management qualifications are desirable.

Core Competencies

Group Financial Leadership

Corporate Finance

Insurance Finance

Investment Finance

Capital & Solvency Management

Asset-Liability Management

Treasury & Liquidity

Financial Planning & Analysis

Investment Analysis

Financial Modeling

Capital Allocation

M&A & Corporate Development

Regulatory Reporting

Risk Management

Investor Relations

Corporate Governance

Finance Transformation

Leadership Characteristics

The successful Group CFO will be:

Strategic, commercially astute, and financially rigorous

Comfortable operating across complex group structures

Strong in capital allocation and investment decisions

Experienced in highly regulated environments

A sophisticated communicator at Board and investor level

Strong in balance-sheet and liquidity management

Comfortable challenging business leaders and driving accountability

Able to balance growth, profitability, capital, liquidity, and risk

An effective partner to the CEO, CIO, CRO, Chief Actuary, and subsidiary CEOs

A transformational leader capable of building a world-class Group Finance function

Compensation

A competitive executive compensation package comprising base salary, performance-based incentives, executive benefits, and other benefits commensurate with experience and market benchmarks.
